```go
package fsm

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/crypto"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/lthash"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

const preTracksGoldenPath = "testdata/pre_tracks_golden.json"

// snodeSigner is the enrolment key of an SNode that the pre-tracks history and
// the tracks fixture (tracks_fixture_test.go) enrol: s1, the founding indexer
// 1's SNode, signs with authoritytest key 0 (indexerSigner1), and s0,
// indexer 0's, with key 1 (indexerSigner2).
func snodeSigner(t testing.TB, node string) *authority.Signer {
	t.Helper()
	switch node {
	case "s1":
		return authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex0)
	case "s0":
		return authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex1)
	}
	t.Fatalf("no enrolment key for SNode %q", node)
	return nil
}

// fixedEnrollmentEntry is siEntry with its enrolment statement signed at
// authoritytest.Iat, so a history that stores it is reproducible.
func fixedEnrollmentEntry(t *testing.T, f *FSM, signer *authority.Signer, indexer, activation uint64, node string) arbiter.SIIndexerEntry {
	t.Helper()
	jws, err := signer.SignSNodeEnrollmentAt(authority.SNodeEnrollmentStatement{NetworkID: f.st.Params.NetworkID,
		GenesisSnapshotID: mustGenesisID(t, f), IndexerID: indexer, SNodeNodeID: node}, authoritytest.Iat)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return arbiter.SIIndexerEntry{IndexerID: indexer, ActivationBlock: activation, Signer: signer.Address(), SNodeNodeID: node, EnrollmentJWS: jws}
}

// ownedClaim is statement stmt's result claim signed by its bound source's
// enrolment key: one candidate part in the statement's own partition p<stmt>
// of its target table, whose LtHash is lthashHex(label), and the matching
// partition sum. It returns the command and the part's LtHash.
func ownedClaim(t *testing.T, f *FSM, stmt uint64, label string) (wire.Command, string) {
	t.Helper()
	ss := f.st.Statements[stmt]
	if ss == nil {
		t.Fatalf("statement %d is not admitted", stmt)
	}
	hash, partition := lthashHex(label), fmt.Sprintf("p%d", stmt)
	_, cmd := signedRC(t, f, snodeSigner(t, ss.SourceNode), arbiter.RCRecord{
		StatementID: ss.Env.StatementID, SourceNode: ss.SourceNode, SourceClaimRoot: "0xclaim",
		CandidateParts: []arbiter.CandidatePart{{TableID: ss.Env.TargetTableID, PartitionID: partition,
			PartName: fmt.Sprintf("all_%d_0", stmt), PartRowLtHash: hash, RowCount: 1, Bytes: 32}},
		PartitionNewPartSums: []arbiter.PartitionLtHashSum{{TableID: ss.Env.TargetTableID, PartitionID: partition, NewPartsLtHashSum: hash}},
	})
	return cmd, hash
}

// pinnedEvidence is the evidence of a correct replay of block seq, already
// marked replaying, by the first two verifiers of its set: attestations whose
// receipts carry the root pinnedBlockState derives and every touched
// partition's post-commitment, and scans that confirm every candidate part. A
// transition block gets an empty receipt and an empty scan (ruling R5).
func pinnedEvidence(t *testing.T, f *FSM, seq uint64) []wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	root, baseRoots, claimed, err := f.pinnedBlockState(seq)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	partitions := make([]arbiter.TablePartition, 0, len(claimed))
	for tp := range claimed {
		partitions = append(partitions, tp)
	}
	sortPartitions(partitions)
	h := f.st.Blocks[seq-1]
	receipt := replay.ExecutionReceipt{BlockSeq: seq, PrevSafeSnapshotID: h.PrevSafeSnapshotID, PrevStateRoot: h.PrevStateRoot,
		SchemaSnapshotID: h.SchemaSnapshotID, ExecutorProfileID: h.ExecutorProfileID, ComputedStateRoot: root}
	for _, tp := range partitions {
		post := lthash.New()
		if base := baseRoots[tp]; base != "" {
			if post, err = lthashFromHex(base); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		post.AddHash(claimed[tp])
		receipt.PartitionCommitmentsAfter = append(receipt.PartitionCommitmentsAfter, replay.PartitionCommitment{
			TableID: tp.TableID, PartitionID: tp.PartitionID, Root: "0x" + hex.EncodeToString(post.Bytes())})
	}
	var scan []arbiter.PartScan
	for _, ss := range f.blockStatements(seq) {
		for _, cp := range ss.RC.CandidateParts {
			scan = append(scan, arbiter.PartScan{TableID: cp.TableID, PartitionID: cp.PartitionID,
				ClaimedPartRowLtHash: cp.PartRowLtHash, ScannedPartRowLtHash: cp.PartRowLtHash})
		}
	}
	set := f.st.Verifications[seq].VerifierSet
	if len(set) < 2 {
		t.Fatalf("block %d is not marked replaying", seq)
	}
	var out []wire.Command
	for _, rid := range set[:2] {
		out = append(out,
			wire.Command{RecordAttestation: &wire.RecordAttestation{Attestation: signedAttestation(t, rid, rid[len(rid)-1], receipt)}},
			wire.Command{RecordByteSideScan: &wire.RecordByteSideScan{Scan: signedScan(t, rid, rid[len(rid)-1], seq, scan)}})
	}
	return out
}

// partPromotion is the authority-signed promotion of statement stmt's one
// candidate part (ownedClaim) under f's next promotion seq, as the first
// promotion of its partition, signed at authoritytest.Iat in f's current
// authority context.
func partPromotion(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer, stmt uint64) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	ss := f.st.Statements[stmt]
	if ss == nil || ss.RC == nil || len(ss.RC.CandidateParts) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("statement %d has no single-part claim", stmt)
	}
	cp := ss.RC.CandidateParts[0]
	promote := arbiter.PromoteSafePartition{TableID: cp.TableID, PartitionID: cp.PartitionID, PromotionSeq: f.st.PromotionSeq + 1,
		CandidateParts: []arbiter.PartRef{{TableID: cp.TableID, PartitionID: cp.PartitionID, PartRowLtHash: cp.PartRowLtHash}}}
	token, err := a.SignPromotionWithContextAt(promote, authorityContextFor(t, f), authoritytest.Iat)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return wire.Command{RecordPromotionIssued: &wire.RecordPromotionIssued{Promote: promote, AuthorityJWS: token}}
}

// partPromotionAck is the applied acknowledgement of promotion p by the
// bound source of the statements it covers, signed by that SNode's enrolment
// key. The partition held no safe part before, so the post-commitment is the
// promoted parts' sum.
func partPromotionAck(t *testing.T, f *FSM, p uint64) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	pp := f.st.PendingPromotions[p]
	if pp == nil || len(pp.StatementSeqs) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("promotion %d is not recorded", p)
	}
	tp := arbiter.TablePartition{TableID: pp.Promote.TableID, PartitionID: pp.Promote.PartitionID}
	if len(f.st.SafeParts[tp]) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("partition %v already holds safe parts", tp)
	}
	sum := lthash.New()
	var parts []arbiter.SafePartMapping
	for i, pr := range pp.Promote.CandidateParts {
		h, err := lthashFromHex(pr.PartRowLtHash)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		sum.AddHash(h)
		parts = append(parts, arbiter.SafePartMapping{PartRowLtHash: pr.PartRowLtHash, SafePartName: fmt.Sprintf("all_%d_%d_%d", p, p, i), PartPhysHash: "fixture-physical"})
	}
	source := f.st.Statements[pp.StatementSeqs[0]].SourceNode
	return sourceAck(t, f, snodeSigner(t, source), arbiter.PromotionAck{NodeID: source, PromotionSeq: p, TableID: tp.TableID,
		PartitionID: tp.PartitionID, PostPartitionCommitment: "0x" + hex.EncodeToString(sum.Bytes()), Parts: parts, Applied: true})
}

// partCleanup is the authority-signed cleanup of promotion p's parts, signed
// at authoritytest.Iat in f's current authority context.
func partCleanup(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer, p uint64) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	pp := f.st.PendingPromotions[p]
	if pp == nil {
		t.Fatalf("promotion %d is not recorded", p)
	}
	cleanup := arbiter.UnsafeCleanup{TableID: pp.Promote.TableID, PartitionID: pp.Promote.PartitionID, PromotionSeq: p,
		Parts: clonePartRefs(pp.Promote.CandidateParts)}
	token, err := a.SignCleanupWithContextAt(cleanup, authorityContextFor(t, f), authoritytest.Iat)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return wire.Command{ScheduleUnsafeCleanup: &wire.ScheduleUnsafeCleanup{Cleanup: cleanup, AuthorityJWS: token}}
}

// partCleanupAck is the acknowledgement of promotion p's cleanup by its
// source, signed by that SNode's enrolment key.
func partCleanupAck(t *testing.T, f *FSM, p uint64) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	pp := f.st.PendingPromotions[p]
	if pp == nil || len(pp.StatementSeqs) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("promotion %d is not recorded", p)
	}
	source := f.st.Statements[pp.StatementSeqs[0]].SourceNode
	return sourceCleanupAck(t, f, snodeSigner(t, source), arbiter.CleanupAck{NodeID: source, PromotionSeq: p,
		TableID: pp.Promote.TableID, PartitionID: pp.Promote.PartitionID})
}

// runPreTracksHistory replays one fixed history that never sets tracks_enabled
// but crosses every path stage 2 of the multi-source network changes
// (housegate spec 2026-10-10 §7): the signed-claims activation with two
// indexers (the founding indexer 1 and indexer 0), indexer 0's seed and both
// owners' adds sealed into one transition block behind the table-set fence,
// statements of both owners in one open block (no owner switch seals before
// the activation), a duplicate, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and LANE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
// the client-lanes activation, verification and finality, promotions refused
// by the global frontier and manifest-debt rules, acknowledgements,
// publications, cleanups and their acknowledgements, a Rejected challenge, an
// authority rotation through the drain gate, and a snapshot-query begin. Every
// step names the answer it must get. It was captured from the release before
// stage 2; never recapture it: a difference means stage 2 replays
// pre-activation history differently.
func runPreTracksHistory(t *testing.T) legacyGolden {
	t.Helper()
	signer, err := authority.NewSignerFromHex(legacyGoldenAuthorityHex)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rotated, err := authority.NewSignerFromHex(preSignedClaimsRotatedAuthorityHex)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	params := testParams()
	params.AuthorityAddresses = []string{signer.Address()}
	params.MaxWriters = 2
	f := mustNewFSM(t, params)
	key, err := crypto.HexToECDSA(legacyGoldenUserKeyHex)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	account := strings.ToLower(crypto.PubkeyToAddress(key.PublicKey).Hex())
	var out legacyGolden
	step := func(c wire.Command, want string) {
		t.Helper()
		got := describeApply(f.Apply(mkLog(t, c)))
		if !strings.HasPrefix(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("history step %d answered %q, want %q", len(out.Results)+1, got, want)
		}
		out.Results = append(out.Results, got)
	}
	submitStep := func(env arbiter.StatementEnvelope, want string) {
		t.Helper()
		step(wire.Command{SubmitStatement: &wire.SubmitStatement{Envelope: env}}, want)
	}
	envFor := func(lane string, seq uint64, table string) arbiter.StatementEnvelope {
		t.Helper()
		env := validEnvelope(t, key, account, seq)
		env.StatementID.ClientLane = lane
		env.TargetTableID = table
		env.SchemaHash = f.st.TableRegistry.Live(table).SchemaHash
		env.UserJWS = signStatementV2(t, key, env)
		return env
	}
	register := func(id string, role arbiter.NodeRole) {
		t.Helper()
		reg := arbiter.NodeRegistration{NodeID: id, Roles: []arbiter.NodeRole{role}}
		if role == arbiter.NodeRoleVerifier {
			reg.Ed25519Pubkey = testPubkey(id[len(id)-1])
		}
		step(wire.Command{RegisterNode: &wire.RegisterNode{Registration: reg}}, "fsm.Applied")
		step(wire.Command{MarkActive: &wire.MarkActive{NodeID: id}}, "fsm.Applied")
	}
	// update is the next consensus update carrying the committed lists.
	update := func(authorities []string, lanes *arbiter.ClientLaneParams) {
		t.Helper()
		u := consensusUpdate(t, f, authorities, 2)
		u.TableRegistry = testRegistryParams()
		u.ClientLanes = lanes
		u.SIIndexers, u.Verifiers = cloneSIIndexers(f.st.Params.SIIndexers), cloneVerifiers(f.st.Params.Verifiers)
		step(signedConsensusUpdate(t, signer, u), "fsm.Applied")
	}
	verify := func(block uint64) {
		t.Helper()
		step(wire.Command{MarkReplaying: &wire.MarkReplaying{BlockSeq: block}}, "fsm.Applied")
		for _, c := range pinnedEvidence(t, f, block) {
			step(c, "fsm.Applied")
		}
		step(wire.Command{RecordAnchorFinality: &wire.RecordAnchorFinality{L3BlockSeq: block, Anchor: anchorForBlock(t, f, block),
			FinalityReached: true, LastMergeableReached: true}}, "fsm.Applied")
	}
	claim := func(stmt uint64) {
		t.Helper()
		cmd, _ := ownedClaim(t, f, stmt, fmt.Sprintf("pre-tracks-row-%d", stmt))
		step(cmd, "fsm.Applied")
	}
	publish := func() {
		t.Helper()
		step(wire.Command{PublishSafeSnapshot: &wire.PublishSafeSnapshot{Manifest: manifestFromInputs(t, f)}}, "fsm.Applied")
	}
	seal := func() { t.Helper(); step(wire.Command{SealL3Block: &wire.SealL3Block{}}, "fsm.SealResult") }

	// Two SNodes and three verifiers, the registry, the founding seed and the
	// signed-claims activation naming the founding indexer 1 (s1) and indexer
	// 0 (s0, activation block 150).
	register("s1", arbiter.NodeRoleSNode)
	register("s0", arbiter.NodeRoleSNode)
	for _, id := range []string{"v1", "v2", "v3"} {
		register(id, arbiter.NodeRoleVerifier)
	}
	update(params.AuthorityAddresses, nil)
	step(wire.Command{SeedLegacyTables: &wire.SeedLegacyTables{AtBlock: arbiter.L2BlockRef{Number: 99, Hash: "0x99"},
		Tables: []arbiter.LegacyTable{{DatabaseID: "db", TableID: "old", Created: ev(5, "0x5", 0)}}}}, "fsm.Applied")
	activation := consensusUpdate(t, f, params.AuthorityAddresses, 2)
	activation.TableRegistry = testRegistryParams()
	activation.SIIndexers = []arbiter.SIIndexerEntry{
		fixedEnrollmentEntry(t, f, snodeSigner(t, "s1"), 1, 100, "s1"),
		fixedEnrollmentEntry(t, f, snodeSigner(t, "s0"), 0, 150, "s0"),
	}
	activation.Verifiers = testVerifiers("v1", "v2", "v3")
	step(signedConsensusUpdate(t, signer, activation), "fsm.Applied")

	// Indexer 0's seed and one add per owner: before the tracks activation
	// both travel in one transition block, and admission is fenced until it
	// seals.
	step(advanceTo(149), "fsm.Applied")
	step(seedIndexerCmd(0, 149), "fsm.Applied")
	step(ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "x", ev(150, "0x150", 0), ev(151, "0x151", 0), 0), "fsm.Applied")
	step(ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db", "y", ev(152, "0x152", 0), ev(153, "0x153", 0), 1), "fsm.Applied")
	submitStep(envFor("", 1, "db.t"), "rejected:table-set transition is pending; retry after it is sealed")
	seal() // block 1
	verify(1)
	publish()

	// Both owners' statements share one open block, a duplicate, a source
	// that re-registers, and the statement admitted once it is Active again.
	submitStep(envFor("", 1, "db.t"), "submit:1:1:")
	submitStep(envFor("", 2, "db0.x"), "submit:1:2:")
	submitStep(envFor("", 3, "db.y"), "submit:1:3:")
	submitStep(envFor("", 2, "db0.x"), "submit:2:0:client_seq already spent")
	step(snodeRegistration(t, f, snodeSigner(t, "s0"), "s0", 1), "fsm.Applied")
	submitStep(envFor("", 4, "db0.x"), "submit:10:0:storage-integrity source s0 of indexer 0 is not active")
	step(snodeMarkActive(t, f, snodeSigner(t, "s0"), "s0", 1), "fsm.Applied")
	submitStep(envFor("", 4, "db0.x"), "submit:1:4:")
	seal() // block 2: statements 1-4 of both owners

	// Client lanes with a one-lane budget: a second lane is refused.
	update(params.AuthorityAddresses, &arbiter.ClientLaneParams{MaxLanesPerAccount: 1})
	submitStep(envFor(testClientLaneA, 1, "db.t"), "submit:1:5:")
	submitStep(envFor(testClientLaneB, 1, "db0.x"), "submit:9:0:account "+account+" already holds 1 client lanes")
	seal() // block 3: statement 5

	// Claims, verification and finality of blocks 2 and 3.
	for stmt := uint64(1); stmt <= 4; stmt++ {
		claim(stmt)
	}
	verify(2)
	claim(5)
	verify(3)

	// The global rules: block 3 is beyond the frontier while block 2 is not
	// safe; once block 2 is safe a new promotion waits for its manifest.
	step(partPromotion(t, f, signer, 5), "rejected:promotion covers statements beyond the safe-prefix frontier")
	for stmt := uint64(1); stmt <= 4; stmt++ {
		step(partPromotion(t, f, signer, stmt), "fsm.Applied")
	}
	for p := uint64(1); p <= 4; p++ {
		step(partPromotionAck(t, f, p), "fsm.Applied")
	}
	step(partPromotion(t, f, signer, 5), "rejected:safe prefix awaits manifest publication before new promotions")
	publish()
	step(partPromotion(t, f, signer, 5), "fsm.Applied")
	step(partPromotionAck(t, f, 5), "fsm.Applied")
	publish()

	// Every promotion's cleanup, acknowledged by its source.
	for p := uint64(1); p <= 5; p++ {
		step(partCleanup(t, f, signer, p), "fsm.Applied")
		step(partCleanupAck(t, f, p), "fsm.Applied")
	}

	// A Rejected challenge: before the tracks activation it quarantines
	// nothing.
	submitStep(envFor("", 5, "db0.x"), "submit:1:6:")
	seal() // block 4
	claim(6)
	step(wire.Command{MarkReplaying: &wire.MarkReplaying{BlockSeq: 4}}, "fsm.Applied")
	step(wire.Command{OpenChallenge: &wire.OpenChallenge{BlockSeq: 4}}, "fsm.Applied")
	step(wire.Command{ResolveChallenge: &wire.ResolveChallenge{BlockSeq: 4, Verdict: wire.ChallengeVerdictRejected}}, "fsm.Applied")

	// An authority rotation through the drain gate, then a snapshot-query
	// begin: before the tracks activation the lane still opens.
	update([]string{rotated.Address()}, &arbiter.ClientLaneParams{MaxLanesPerAccount: 1})
	step(wire.Command{BeginSnapshotQuery: &wire.BeginSnapshotQuery{Request: signedAcquireRequest(t, snapshotQueryTestSigner(t), "statement-1", "request-1")}}, "fsm.Applied")

	for _, h := range f.st.Blocks {
		hash, err := h.ChainHash()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out.ChainHashes = append(out.ChainHashes, hash)
	}
	out.SpentIDsRoot = "0x" + hex.EncodeToString(f.st.SpentIDs.Root())
	b := snapshotBytes(t, f)
	out.SnapshotVersion = b[4]
	sum := sha256.Sum256(b)
	out.SnapshotSHA256 = hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	return out
}

func TestPreActivationHistoryIsByteIdenticalAcrossTracks(t *testing.T) {
	got := runPreTracksHistory(t)
	if os.Getenv("ARBITER_CAPTURE_PRE_TRACKS_GOLDEN") == "1" {
		if _, err := os.Stat(preTracksGoldenPath); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s exists; it is captured once from the release before stage 2 and never rewritten", preTracksGoldenPath)
		}
		b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(got, "", "  ")
		if err := os.WriteFile(preTracksGoldenPath, append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Skip("captured; commit the file")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(preTracksGoldenPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var want legacyGolden
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &want); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		gb, _ := json.MarshalIndent(got, "", "  ")
		t.Fatalf("pre-activation history replays differently from the release before stage 2:\n%s", gb)
	}
	if len(got.Results) != 88 || len(got.ChainHashes) != 4 || got.SnapshotVersion != snapshotVersionV19 {
		t.Fatalf("the history must answer 88 commands, seal four blocks and write v19, got %d answers, %d blocks and v%d",
			len(got.Results), len(got.ChainHashes), got.SnapshotVersion)
	}
}
```

Create `fsm/tracks_fixture_test.go`, the two-indexer fixture Tasks 7–15 build on:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"crypto/ecdsa"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"testing"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// The tracks fixture (housegate spec 2026-10-10 §7) is ownerFSMWithAuthority's
// two-owner network with the second indexer numbered 0, so a real track has
// id 0 and is never confused with "no owner": the founding indexer 1 (SNode
// s1, authoritytest key 0) owns the genesis table db.t, and indexer 0 (SNode
// s0, activation block 150, authoritytest key 1) owns db0.x, made Active
// through transition block 1. Verifiers v1..v3 are registered, Active and
// listed. Every claim it binds puts its one candidate part in the statement's
// own partition p<statement seq> (ownedClaim).

// trackTable is the Active table owner's statements target.
func trackTable(owner uint64) string {
	if owner == 0 {
		return "db0.x"
	}
	return "db.t"
}

// trackSNode is owner's SNode.
func trackSNode(owner uint64) string { return fmt.Sprintf("s%d", owner) }

// tracksReadyFSM is the two-owner network after the signed-claims activation
// and before the tracks activation, meeting every activation precondition:
// the open block is empty, sealed block 1 (indexer 0's add transition) is
// safe and published, the artifact disposition capability is 0 and the
// snapshot-query barrier is idle. It returns the network authority.
func tracksReadyFSM(t *testing.T) (*FSM, *authority.Signer) {
	t.Helper()
	f, a := claimsFSM(t)
	registerActive(t, f, "s0", arbiter.NodeRoleSNode)
	activateClaims(t, f, a, siEntry(t, f, indexerSigner2(t), 0, 150, "s0"))
	mustApply(t, f, advanceTo(149))
	mustApply(t, f, seedIndexerCmd(0, 149))
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "x", ev(150, "0x150", 0), ev(151, "0x151", 0), 0))
	seq := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	verifyTransition(t, f, seq)
	anchorFinal(t, f, seq)
	publishManifestInputs(t, f)
	if inc := f.st.TableRegistry.Live("db0.x"); inc == nil || inc.Status != TableStatusActive || inc.OwnerIndexerID == nil || *inc.OwnerIndexerID != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("db0.x = %+v, want Active and owned by indexer 0", inc)
	}
	return f, a
}

// tracksUpdate is f's next consensus update after the signed-claims
// activation: claimsUpdate carrying the committed si_indexers and verifiers,
// with tracks_enabled set.
func tracksUpdate(t *testing.T, f *FSM) arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate {
	t.Helper()
	u := claimsUpdate(t, f, cloneSIIndexers(f.st.Params.SIIndexers), cloneVerifiers(f.st.Params.Verifiers))
	u.TracksEnabled = true
	return u
}

// activateTracks commits the tracks activation on f.
func activateTracks(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer) {
	t.Helper()
	mustApply(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, tracksUpdate(t, f)))
	if !f.TracksActive() || f.st.Tracks == nil {
		t.Fatal("the tracks activation did not commit")
	}
}

// tracksFSM is tracksReadyFSM after the tracks activation: cutover {block 1,
// promotion 0} and the initial entries {0, 1, 0} and {1, 1, 0}.
func tracksFSM(t *testing.T) (*FSM, *authority.Signer) {
	t.Helper()
	f, a := tracksReadyFSM(t)
	activateTracks(t, f, a)
	return f, a
}

// trackEnvelope is account's statement seq on lane (empty: the legacy lane)
// for owner's table, under its registered schema hash.
func trackEnvelope(t *testing.T, f *FSM, key *ecdsa.PrivateKey, account, lane string, seq, owner uint64) arbiter.StatementEnvelope {
	t.Helper()
	inc := f.st.TableRegistry.Live(trackTable(owner))
	if inc == nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s is not registered", trackTable(owner))
	}
	env := validEnvelope(t, key, account, seq)
	env.StatementID.ClientLane = lane
	env.TargetTableID = trackTable(owner)
	env.SchemaHash = inc.SchemaHash
	env.UserJWS = signStatementV2(t, key, env)
	return env
}

// admitTrack submits account's legacy-lane statement seq for owner's table,
// requires it to be admitted and returns its statement seq.
func admitTrack(t *testing.T, f *FSM, key *ecdsa.PrivateKey, account string, seq, owner uint64) uint64 {
	t.Helper()
	r := submit(t, f, trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, "", seq, owner))
	if r.Code != arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted {
		t.Fatalf("statement %d for indexer %d = %+v", seq, owner, r)
	}
	return r.StatementSeq
}

// bindTrackClaim binds statement stmt's signed result claim (ownedClaim) and
// returns its one part's LtHash.
func bindTrackClaim(t *testing.T, f *FSM, stmt uint64) string {
	t.Helper()
	cmd, hash := ownedClaim(t, f, stmt, fmt.Sprintf("track-row-%d", stmt))
	mustApply(t, f, cmd)
	return hash
}

// verifyBlock marks block seq replaying and records two verifiers' passing
// evidence over its pinned state (pinnedEvidence).
func verifyBlock(t *testing.T, f *FSM, seq uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	mustApply(t, f, wire.Command{MarkReplaying: &wire.MarkReplaying{BlockSeq: seq}})
	for _, c := range pinnedEvidence(t, f, seq) {
		mustApply(t, f, c)
	}
}

// promoteTrack issues the promotion of statement stmt's one part and returns
// its promotion seq.
func promoteTrack(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer, stmt uint64) uint64 {
	t.Helper()
	cmd := partPromotion(t, f, a, stmt)
	mustApply(t, f, cmd)
	return cmd.RecordPromotionIssued.Promote.PromotionSeq
}

// ackTrackPromotion applies the source's acknowledgement of promotion p.
func ackTrackPromotion(t *testing.T, f *FSM, p uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	mustApply(t, f, partPromotionAck(t, f, p))
}

// cleanTrackPromotion schedules the cleanup of promotion p and applies its
// source's acknowledgement.
func cleanTrackPromotion(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer, p uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	mustApply(t, f, partCleanup(t, f, a, p))
	mustApply(t, f, partCleanupAck(t, f, p))
}

// passTrackBlock admits account's statements seqs for owner, seals them into
// one block, binds their claims, verifies the block, makes it final, and
// promotes and acknowledges each statement, so the block passes. The open
// block must be empty, and the promotions must be issuable: before the
// tracks activation under the global rules, after it under owner's track
// rules (a track that owes a manifest entry issues nothing). It returns the
// block and the promotions in statement order.
func passTrackBlock(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer, key *ecdsa.PrivateKey, account string, owner uint64, seqs ...uint64) (uint64, []uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	if len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("passTrackBlock needs an empty open block")
	}
	var stmts []uint64
	for _, seq := range seqs {
		stmts = append(stmts, admitTrack(t, f, key, account, seq, owner))
	}
	block := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	for _, s := range stmts {
		bindTrackClaim(t, f, s)
	}
	verifyBlock(t, f, block)
	anchorFinal(t, f, block)
	var promotions []uint64
	for _, s := range stmts {
		p := promoteTrack(t, f, a, s)
		ackTrackPromotion(t, f, p)
		promotions = append(promotions, p)
	}
	return block, promotions
}

// setPublishedTrackFrontiers stands in for a track-aware publication (Task 9,
// contract §3.4) in unit tests of the per-track rules: it sets the
// track_frontiers of the latest published manifest, which
// publishedTrackFrontierLocked reads. Nothing in those tests recomputes the
// stored manifest's root.
func setPublishedTrackFrontiers(t *testing.T, f *FSM, frontiers ...replay.TrackFrontier) {
	t.Helper()
	m := f.st.Manifests[f.st.SafeWatermark.SnapshotID]
	if m == nil {
		t.Fatal("no published manifest")
	}
	m.TrackFrontiers = slices.Clone(frontiers)
}

// trackStateJSON is f's track state as canonical JSON, for comparisons the
// snapshot document cannot make before snapshot v20 (Task 12).
func trackStateJSON(t *testing.T, f *FSM) string {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := json.Marshal(f.st.Tracks)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

// rejectTracksUnchanged is rejectSignedUnchanged that also compares the track
// state, which only snapshot v20 (Task 12) adds to the snapshot document.
func rejectTracksUnchanged(t *testing.T, f *FSM, cmd wire.Command, reason string) {
	t.Helper()
	before := trackStateJSON(t, f)
	rejectSignedUnchanged(t, f, cmd, reason)
	if after := trackStateJSON(t, f); after != before {
		t.Fatalf("a rejected command changed the track state:\n%s\n%s", before, after)
	}
}

// forgeConsensusChange appends cmd's signed update to f's committed history
// without applying it, the way a forged container would carry it.
func forgeConsensusChange(t *testing.T, f *FSM, cmd wire.Command) {
	t.Helper()
	f.st.ConsensusUpdates = append(f.st.ConsensusUpdates, ConsensusParamsChange{Update: cmd.UpdateConsensusParams.Update,
		AuthorityJWS: cmd.UpdateConsensusParams.AuthorityJWS})
	f.st.ConsensusEpoch++
}
```

```go
// Clarification C11: tracks_enabled is set only by an update after the one

	t.Run("before the signed-claims activation", func(t *testing.T) {

		u := claimsUpdate(t, f, nil, nil)
		u.TracksEnabled = true

	})
	t.Run("together with the signed-claims activation", func(t *testing.T) {

		u.TracksEnabled = true
		rejectTracksUnchanged(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, u), want)
		if f.SignedClaimsActive() || f.TracksActive() {
			t.Fatal("a refused combined update activated signed claims or tracks")
		}

}

// tracks_enabled is raise-only: every update after the activation carries it.

	// An authority change too, so only the tracks rule can refuse it.
	omitted.AuthorityAddresses = []string{b.Address()}
	rejectTracksUnchanged(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, omitted), "consensus update must carry tracks_enabled once set")
	carried := tracksUpdate(t, f)

// Clarification C2 and contract §3.1: the activation's own refusals, in
// their order, after the writer and drain gates and before any mutation.
func TestTracksActivationRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	acquire := func(t *testing.T, f *FSM) {
		t.Helper()
		mustApply(t, f, wire.Command{BeginSnapshotQuery: &wire.BeginSnapshotQuery{
			Request: signedAcquireRequest(t, snapshotQueryTestSigner(t), "statement-1", "request-1")}})
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		setup  func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer) arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate
		reason string
	}{
		{"an open block", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer) arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate {
			admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
			return tracksUpdate(t, f)
		}, "tracks activation requires an empty open block"},
		{"a sealed block that is not safe", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer) arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate {
			admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
			mustSeal(t, f)
			return tracksUpdate(t, f)
		}, "tracks activation requires every sealed block to be safe"},
		{"a safe prefix no manifest covers", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer) arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate {
			_, promotions := passTrackBlock(t, f, a, key, account, 1, 1)
			cleanTrackPromotion(t, f, a, promotions[0])
			return tracksUpdate(t, f)
		}, "tracks activation requires the published manifest to cover the sealed tip"},
		{"artifact disposition capability 1", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer) arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate {
			raise := claimsUpdate(t, f, cloneSIIndexers(f.st.Params.SIIndexers), cloneVerifiers(f.st.Params.Verifiers))
			raise.ArtifactDispositionCapability = 1
			mustApply(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, raise))
			activation := tracksUpdate(t, f)
			activation.ArtifactDispositionCapability = 1
			return activation
		}, "tracks activation requires artifact disposition capability 0"},
		{"a busy snapshot-query barrier", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer) arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate {
			acquire(t, f)
			return tracksUpdate(t, f)
		}, "tracks activation requires an idle snapshot-query barrier"},
		{"the first refusal answers", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer) arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate {
			admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
			acquire(t, f)
			return tracksUpdate(t, f)
		}, "tracks activation requires an empty open block"},
		{"the drain gate answers before them", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer) arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate {
			s := admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
			block := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
			bindTrackClaim(t, f, s)
			verifyBlock(t, f, block)
			anchorFinal(t, f, block)
			promoteTrack(t, f, a, s) // issued, never acknowledged; the block is not safe either
			return tracksUpdate(t, f)
		}, "consensus update requires all promotions to be acknowledged"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f, a := tracksReadyFSM(t)
			update := tc.setup(t, f, a)
			rejectTracksUnchanged(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, update), tc.reason)
			if f.TracksActive() || f.st.Tracks != nil {
				t.Fatal("a refused activation enabled tracks")
			}
		})
	}
}

// Contract §3.1: the activation records the cutover and one initial entry per
// enrolled indexer, equal to the cutover, and changes no registry view.
func TestTracksActivationRecordsTheCutover(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("at the fixture's tip", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, a := tracksReadyFSM(t)
		version, epoch := f.st.TableRegistry.Version, f.st.ConsensusEpoch
		changed := f.RegistryChanged()
		activateTracks(t, f, a)
		want := TrackState{Cutover: TrackCutover{BlockSeq: 1}, Indexers: []IndexerTrack{
			{IndexerID: 0, Initial: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 0, SafeBlockSeq: 1}},
			{IndexerID: 1, Initial: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 1}},
		}}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(*f.st.Tracks, want) {
			t.Fatalf("track state = %+v, want %+v", *f.st.Tracks, want)
		}
		if !f.st.Params.TracksEnabled || f.st.ConsensusEpoch != epoch+1 || f.st.TableRegistry.Version != version {
			t.Fatalf("tracks_enabled %v, epoch %d -> %d, registry version %d -> %d", f.st.Params.TracksEnabled, epoch, f.st.ConsensusEpoch, version, f.st.TableRegistry.Version)
		}
		select {
		case <-changed:
			t.Fatal("the activation woke registry watchers, but the registry view did not change")
		default:
		}
	})
	t.Run("after promotions", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, a := tracksReadyFSM(t)
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		block, promotions := passTrackBlock(t, f, a, key, account, 1, 1)
		cleanTrackPromotion(t, f, a, promotions[0])
		publishManifestInputs(t, f)
		activateTracks(t, f, a)
		if got, want := f.st.Tracks.Cutover, (TrackCutover{BlockSeq: block, PromotionSeq: 1}); got != want {
			t.Fatalf("cutover = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
		}
		for _, tr := range f.st.Tracks.Indexers {
			if want := (replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: tr.IndexerID, SafeBlockSeq: block, AppliedPromotionSeq: 1}); tr.Initial != want {
				t.Fatalf("indexer %d initial entry = %+v, want %+v", tr.IndexerID, tr.Initial, want)
			}
		}
	})
}

// Spec 2026-10-10 §7.6: an indexer enrolled after the activation starts from
// {global prefix, PromotionSeq} at its enrolment commit, and the earlier
// entries keep the cutover.
func TestEnrolmentAfterTheTracksActivationAddsAnInitialEntry(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := tracksFSM(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	block, promotions := passTrackBlock(t, f, a, key, account, 1, 1)
	cleanTrackPromotion(t, f, a, promotions[0]) // the drain gate needs no promoted-unsafe part
	if safePrefixLocked(f) != block || f.st.PromotionSeq != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("fixture: prefix %d, promotion seq %d", safePrefixLocked(f), f.st.PromotionSeq)
	}
	version := f.st.TableRegistry.Version
	si := append(cloneSIIndexers(f.st.Params.SIIndexers), siEntry(t, f, authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.StrangerKeyHex), 2, 200, "s2"))
	u := claimsUpdate(t, f, si, cloneVerifiers(f.st.Params.Verifiers))

	mustApply(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, u))
	want := []IndexerTrack{
		{IndexerID: 0, Initial: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 0, SafeBlockSeq: 1}},
		{IndexerID: 1, Initial: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 1}},
		{IndexerID: 2, Initial: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 2, SafeBlockSeq: block, AppliedPromotionSeq: 1}},
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(f.st.Tracks.Indexers, want) || f.st.Tracks.Cutover != (TrackCutover{BlockSeq: 1}) {
		t.Fatalf("tracks = %+v, want indexers %+v and the cutover kept", *f.st.Tracks, want)
	}
	if f.st.TableRegistry.Version != version+1 {
		t.Fatalf("registry version %d -> %d, want one bump, the enrolment's", version, f.st.TableRegistry.Version)
	}
}

func TestPreTracksParamsDigestIsTheStageOneDigest(t *testing.T) {

	// declaration order, the order CanonicalDigest's json.Marshal emits.

		ExecutorProfileID             string                       `json:"executor_profile_id"`

func TestTrackHelpers(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := tracksReadyFSM(t)
	if f.tracksActiveLocked() || f.TracksActive() || f.indexerTrackLocked(0) != nil {
		t.Fatal("tracks are active before the activation")
	}
	if got := f.incarnationOwnerLocked(f.st.TableRegistry.Live("db0.x")); got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("owner of db0.x = %d, want 0", got)
	}
	if got := f.incarnationOwnerLocked(f.st.TableRegistry.Live("db.t")); got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("owner of db.t = %d, want 1", got)
	}
	// An incarnation without a recorded owner belongs to the founding indexer.
	if got := f.incarnationOwnerLocked(&TableIncarnation{}); got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("owner of an unowned incarnation = %d, want the founding indexer 1", got)
	}
	if source, unavailable := f.ownerSourceLocked(f.st.TableRegistry.Live("db0.x")); source != "s0" || unavailable != "" {
		t.Fatalf("ownerSourceLocked(db0.x) = %q %q", source, unavailable)
	}
	activateTracks(t, f, a)
	if tr := f.indexerTrackLocked(0); tr == nil || tr.IndexerID != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("indexerTrackLocked(0) = %+v", tr)
	}
	if tr := f.indexerTrackLocked(1); tr == nil || tr.IndexerID != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("indexerTrackLocked(1) = %+v", tr)
	}
	if f.indexerTrackLocked(2) != nil {
		t.Fatal("an indexer without an si_indexers entry has a track")
	}
}
```

Create `fsm/tracks.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"cmp"
	"slices"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
)

// Stage 2 of the multi-source storage-integrity network (housegate spec
// 2026-10-10 §7) starts with one authority-signed update that sets
// tracks_enabled after the signed-claims activation: the tracks activation.
// Before it every behaviour is byte for byte stage 1's.

// TrackState is the replicated stage-2 state (spec §7.4–§7.6). It exists
// exactly when Params.TracksEnabled is committed.
type TrackState struct {
	// Cutover is the sealed tip and PromotionSeq when the activation applied.
	Cutover TrackCutover `json:"cutover"`
	// Indexers has one entry per si_indexers entry, sorted by indexer id.
	Indexers []IndexerTrack `json:"indexers"`
	// RejectedParts are the candidate parts of acknowledged rejected blocks
	// that still await their cleanup (clarification C4), sorted by
	// (block, table, partition).
	RejectedParts []RejectedPartition `json:"rejected_parts,omitempty"`
}

// TrackCutover is the activation point (spec §7.6).
type TrackCutover struct {
	BlockSeq     uint64 `json:"block_seq"`
	PromotionSeq uint64 `json:"promotion_seq"`
}

// IndexerTrack is one SI indexer's track state.
type IndexerTrack struct {
	IndexerID uint64 `json:"indexer_id"`
	// Initial is the track's frontier before its first own block: the cutover
	// for an indexer enrolled at the activation, {global prefix, PromotionSeq}
	// at its enrolment commit for one enrolled later (spec §7.6).
	Initial replay.TrackFrontier `json:"initial"`
	// QuarantineGeneration starts at 0 and is incremented by every applied
	// quarantine, release and automatic quarantine (spec §7.4).
	QuarantineGeneration uint64 `json:"quarantine_generation"`
	Quarantined          bool   `json:"quarantined,omitempty"`
	QuarantineReason     string `json:"quarantine_reason,omitempty"`
	// Rejected lists this track's rejected blocks a release has not yet
	// acknowledged; Acknowledged lists those it has (spec §7.5). Both ascending.
	Rejected     []uint64 `json:"rejected,omitempty"`
	Acknowledged []uint64 `json:"acknowledged,omitempty"`
}

// RejectedPartition is the cleanup work of one acknowledged rejected block in
// one partition (clarification C4): Parts not yet acknowledged as dropped,
// and the scheduled cleanup once ScheduleUnsafeCleanup recorded it.
type RejectedPartition struct {
	BlockSeq       uint64                 `json:"block_seq"`
	TableID        string                 `json:"table_id"`
	PartitionID    string                 `json:"partition_id"`
	Parts          []arbiter.PartRef      `json:"parts"`
	Scheduled      *arbiter.UnsafeCleanup `json:"scheduled,omitempty"`
	AuthorityJWS   string                 `json:"authority_jws,omitempty"`
	AuthorityEpoch uint64                 `json:"authority_epoch,omitempty"`
}

// tracksActiveLocked reports whether the tracks activation has committed. The
// caller holds f.mu.
func (f *FSM) tracksActiveLocked() bool { return f.st.Params.TracksEnabled }

// TracksActive is tracksActiveLocked for readers outside Apply.
func (f *FSM) TracksActive() bool {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()
	return f.tracksActiveLocked()
}

// indexerTrackLocked is indexer id's track entry, or nil when Tracks is nil or
// id has no entry. The pointer addresses committed state and stays valid
// until an enrolment appends an entry (enrolTracksLocked).
func (f *FSM) indexerTrackLocked(id uint64) *IndexerTrack {
	if f.st.Tracks == nil {
		return nil
	}
	i, ok := slices.BinarySearchFunc(f.st.Tracks.Indexers, id, func(e IndexerTrack, id uint64) int { return cmp.Compare(e.IndexerID, id) })
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	return &f.st.Tracks.Indexers[i]
}

// incarnationOwnerLocked is the indexer that owns inc: its recorded owner, or
// the founding indexer (TableRegistryParams.SIIndexerID) for an incarnation
// recorded without one, the stage-1 founding rule ownerSourceLocked shares.
// The caller has the table registry enabled, as every signed-claims caller
// does.
func (f *FSM) incarnationOwnerLocked(inc *TableIncarnation) uint64 {
	if inc != nil && inc.OwnerIndexerID != nil {
		return *inc.OwnerIndexerID
	}
	return f.st.Params.TableRegistry.SIIndexerID
}

// tracksActivationRefusalLocked is why the update that first sets
// tracks_enabled cannot apply now, or "" (spec 2026-10-10 §7.6, clarifications
// C2, C7). applyUpdateConsensusParams checks it after the writer and drain
// gates and before any mutation, in this order: the open block is empty,
// every sealed block is safe, the published manifest covers the sealed tip
// (so no manifest is owed and the latest manifest holds every promotion up to
// PromotionSeq), the artifact disposition capability is 0, and the
// snapshot-query barrier is idle.
func (f *FSM) tracksActivationRefusalLocked() string {
	tip := uint64(len(f.st.Blocks))
	switch {
	case len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 0:
		return "tracks activation requires an empty open block"
	case safePrefixLocked(f) != tip:
		return "tracks activation requires every sealed block to be safe"
	case f.st.SafeWatermark.SafeBlockSeq != tip:
		return "tracks activation requires the published manifest to cover the sealed tip"
	case f.st.ArtifactDisposition.Capability != 0:
		return "tracks activation requires artifact disposition capability 0"
	case normalizedArtifactDispositionReservationBarrier(f.st.ArtifactDisposition.ReservationBarrier).State != ArtifactReservationIdle:
		return "tracks activation requires an idle snapshot-query barrier"
	}
	return ""
}

// activateTracksLocked applies the tracks activation (spec 2026-10-10 §7.6)
// after the new params are in place: the cutover is the sealed tip and
// PromotionSeq, and every enrolled indexer's initial entry equals it.
func (f *FSM) activateTracksLocked() {
	cutover := TrackCutover{BlockSeq: uint64(len(f.st.Blocks)), PromotionSeq: f.st.PromotionSeq}
	tracks := &TrackState{Cutover: cutover, Indexers: make([]IndexerTrack, 0, len(f.st.Params.SIIndexers))}
	for _, e := range f.st.Params.SIIndexers {
		tracks.Indexers = append(tracks.Indexers, IndexerTrack{IndexerID: e.IndexerID,
			Initial: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: e.IndexerID, SafeBlockSeq: cutover.BlockSeq, AppliedPromotionSeq: cutover.PromotionSeq}})
	}
	sortIndexerTracks(tracks.Indexers)
	f.st.Tracks = tracks
}

// enrolTracksLocked gives every si_indexers entry without a track entry,
// that is every indexer an update after the activation enrols, its initial
// entry {global prefix, PromotionSeq} at this enrolment commit (spec
// 2026-10-10 §7.6). It runs after the new params are in place. The entries
// are re-sorted after each append, because indexerTrackLocked binary-searches
// them for the next si_indexers entry.
func (f *FSM) enrolTracksLocked() {
	for _, e := range f.st.Params.SIIndexers {
		if f.indexerTrackLocked(e.IndexerID) != nil {
			continue
		}
		f.st.Tracks.Indexers = append(f.st.Tracks.Indexers, IndexerTrack{IndexerID: e.IndexerID,
			Initial: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: e.IndexerID, SafeBlockSeq: safePrefixLocked(f), AppliedPromotionSeq: f.st.PromotionSeq}})
		sortIndexerTracks(f.st.Tracks.Indexers)
	}
}

func sortIndexerTracks(tracks []IndexerTrack) {
	slices.SortFunc(tracks, func(a, b IndexerTrack) int { return cmp.Compare(a.IndexerID, b.IndexerID) })
}
```

Notes:
- **Before the activation** `applySealL3Block` answers and seals exactly as before: `prepareStatementSealLocked` builds the same header with the same refusal reasons in the same order (the owner check runs only after the activation), `commitSealLocked` is the old tail, and both callers of `fillSealedHeaderChainFieldsLocked` that remain pass today's root. Admission seals nothing and never writes `Owner`; transition planning keeps the global rule. `TestPreActivationHistoryIsByteIdenticalAcrossTracks`, `TestPreActivationHistoryIsByteIdenticalAcrossSignedClaims`, `TestLegacyHistoryIsByteIdenticalAcrossTheLaneRelease`, `TestL3CommitmentPreimagesAreFrozen`, `TestL3TransitionHeaderPreimageIsFrozen` and `TestSealStampsTheGoldenPreimage` must pass unchanged.
- **Admission order after this task:** shape, kind, signature, schema allowlist, duplicate, snapshot-query fence, table-set fence, the owner (`incarnationOwnerLocked(live)`, after the activation), SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, the lane budget, the owner-switch seal preparation, the spent-ids insert (gap budget), the seal commit, then the assignment. Task 10 inserts the quarantine answer directly after the owner is computed and before the SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE check (clarification C9), where `owner` is already in scope. Every refusal, the gap budget included, leaves state unchanged because nothing mutates before the insert and `SpentIDs.Insert` is atomic (`accumulator/state.go:41-90`: every budget check runs before any mutation).
- **The prepared seal** carries the open block's statement seqs and a header whose `spent_ids_root_after` is the root before the switching statement's insert; between prepare and commit only that insert runs, which touches neither `Blocks`, `NextL3BlockSeq`, the open block nor any statement record. The commit resets the open block at `NextStatementSeq`, which is still the switching statement's seq, so the statement opens the next block.
- **Events.** A switch seal emits `EventBlockSealed` before the statement's `EventAdmitted`, both from the one `SubmitStatement` Apply. `SubmitResult` does not change. Task 13 records seal times from `EventBlockSealed`, not only around the orchestrator's own proposals.
- **Transitions.** After the activation `plannedTableSetTransitionLocked` delegates to `plannedTrackTransitionLocked`: the lowest owner that has changes, no transition block of its own above `publishedTrackFrontierLocked(owner).SafeBlockSeq`, and a change set that fits the published base, which every block pins; its block carries that owner's track. The fence holds while any owner can seal; `TableSetTransitionUnsealable` names the lowest owner whose change does not fit. `pendingTableSetChangesLocked` keeps its signature because `fsm/table_set_transition_plan_test.go:35` calls it (Contract conflict G3-3).
- **Until Task 9.** Two tracks' transitions may now be pinned to the same base, which today's `manifestInputsAtLocked` (running union, `fsm/reads_manifest.go:62-83`) cannot publish; Task 9 replaces it (clarification C1). No test in this task publishes after two unpublished transitions. `publishedTrackFrontierLocked` reads the latest published manifest's `TrackFrontiers`, which no publication carries before Task 9, so per-track publication is stood in for by `setPublishedTrackFrontiers` (Facts for other tasks).

```go
func TestL3TrackHeaderPreimagesAreFrozen(t *testing.T) {
	transition := goldenTransitionHeader()
	transition.Track = &L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 1}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, preimage, digest string
		header                 L3BlockHeader
	}{
		{"statement block of indexer 0", goldenTrack0HeaderJSON, goldenTrack0HeaderChainHash, goldenTrackHeader(0)},
		{"statement block of indexer 1", goldenTrack1HeaderJSON, goldenTrack1HeaderChainHash, goldenTrackHeader(1)},
		{"transition block of indexer 1", goldenTrack1TransitionHeaderJSON, goldenTrack1TransitionHeaderChainHash, transition},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			assertMarshalsTo(t, tc.name, tc.header, json.RawMessage(tc.preimage))
			if got, err := tc.header.ChainHash(); err != nil || got != tc.digest {
				t.Fatalf("ChainHash = %s (%v), want %s", got, err, tc.digest)
			}
			anchored := tc.header
			anchored.L2AnchorRef = &arbiter.AnchorRef{L3BlockHash: "0xdeadbeef"}
			if got, err := anchored.ChainHash(); err != nil || got != tc.digest {
				t.Fatalf("anchored ChainHash = %s (%v), want %s: the back-filled anchor stays out of the preimage", got, err, tc.digest)
			}
		})
	}
	for _, digest := range []string{goldenTrack0HeaderChainHash, goldenTrack1HeaderChainHash, goldenTrack1TransitionHeaderChainHash} {
		if digest == goldenHeaderChainHash || digest == goldenTransitionHeaderChainHash {
			t.Fatal("a track must change the chain hash")
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package fsm

import (

// refusedOwnerSwitch submits env, a statement for another owner than the
// open block's, and requires that it changed nothing (Review Focus 1): no
// block is sealed, and the snapshot and the track state are byte-identical.
// It returns the answer.
func refusedOwnerSwitch(t *testing.T, f *FSM, env arbiter.StatementEnvelope) any {
	t.Helper()
	blocks, before, tracks := len(f.st.Blocks), snapshotBytes(t, f), trackStateJSON(t, f)
	got := f.Apply(mkLog(t, wire.Command{SubmitStatement: &wire.SubmitStatement{Envelope: env}}))
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks || !bytes.Equal(before, snapshotBytes(t, f)) || trackStateJSON(t, f) != tracks {
		t.Fatalf("a refused owner switch (%+v) changed state", got)
	}
	return got
}

// Spec 2026-10-10 §7.1, clarification C10: a statement for another owner
// seals the open block inside its own admission, with the spent-ids root as
// it was before the statement's insert, and opens the next block.
func TestOwnerSwitchSealsBeforeTheInsert(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := tracksFSM(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	first := admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
	second := admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 2, 1)
	if ob := f.st.OpenBlock; ob.Owner == nil || *ob.Owner != 1 || !slices.Equal(ob.StatementSeqs, []uint64{first, second}) {
		t.Fatalf("open block = %+v, want indexer 1's statements %d and %d", ob, first, second)
	}
	before, blocks := "0x"+hex.EncodeToString(f.st.SpentIDs.Root()), len(f.st.Blocks)
	r := submit(t, f, trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, "", 3, 0))
	if r != (SubmitResult{Code: arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted, StatementSeq: second + 1}) {
		t.Fatalf("switching statement = %+v; the answer must not change", r)
	}
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks+1 {
		t.Fatalf("blocks %d -> %d, want exactly one owner-switch seal", blocks, len(f.st.Blocks))
	}
	h := f.st.Blocks[len(f.st.Blocks)-1]
	if h.Track == nil || h.Track.IndexerID != 1 || h.StatementSeqStart != first || h.StatementCount != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("sealed header = %+v, want indexer 1's two statements", h)
	}
	if h.SpentIDsRootAfter != before || h.SpentIDsRootAfter == "0x"+hex.EncodeToString(f.st.SpentIDs.Root()) {
		t.Fatal("spent_ids_root_after must be the root before the switching statement's insert")
	}
	if _, err := h.ChainHash(); err != nil || h.PrevL3Hash == "" {
		t.Fatalf("sealed header does not chain: %v", err)
	}
	for _, seq := range []uint64{first, second} {
		if f.st.Statements[seq].BlockSeq != h.L3BlockSeq {
			t.Fatalf("statement %d was not stamped into block %d", seq, h.L3BlockSeq)
		}
	}
	if bv := f.st.Verifications[h.L3BlockSeq]; bv == nil || !slices.Equal(bv.SourceNodes, []string{trackSNode(1)}) {
		t.Fatalf("verification record = %+v", bv)
	}
	if ob := f.st.OpenBlock; ob.Owner == nil || *ob.Owner != 0 || ob.StatementSeqStart != r.StatementSeq ||
		!slices.Equal(ob.StatementSeqs, []uint64{r.StatementSeq}) || f.st.Statements[r.StatementSeq].BlockSeq != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("open block after the switch = %+v", ob)
	}
	// A statement of the open block's owner joins it without a seal.
	admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 4, 0)
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks+1 || len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 2 || *f.st.OpenBlock.Owner != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a statement of the open block's owner sealed: open block %+v", f.st.OpenBlock)
	}
}

// Review Focus 1: an owner switch that meets a refusal seals nothing, whether
// the refusal comes before the seal is prepared or from the insert after it.
// Quarantine joins these cases with QuarantineIndexer (Task 10).
func TestRefusedOwnerSwitchSealsNothing(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("duplicate client_seq", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, _ := tracksFSM(t)
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 0)
		mustSeal(t, f)
		admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 2, 1)
		got := refusedOwnerSwitch(t, f, trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, "", 1, 0))
		want := SubmitResult{Code: arbiter.AdmissionCodeDuplicateClientSeq, Message: "client_seq already spent (client bug: do not retry with the same seq)"}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("answer = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
		}
	})
	t.Run("table-set fence", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, _ := tracksFSM(t)
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
		mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "y", ev(152, "0x152", 0), ev(153, "0x153", 0), 0))
		got := refusedOwnerSwitch(t, f, trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, "", 2, 0))
		if want := (Rejected{Reason: TableSetTransitionAdmissionFencedReason}); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("answer = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
		}
	})
	t.Run("SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, _ := tracksFSM(t)
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
		f.st.Nodes[trackSNode(0)].Status = NodeSyncing
		env := trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, "", 2, 0)
		want := SubmitResult{Code: arbiter.AdmissionCodeSourceUnavailable, Message: "storage-integrity source s0 of indexer 0 is not active"}
		if got := refusedOwnerSwitch(t, f, env); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("answer = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
		}
		// Once the source is back the same statement switches owners.
		f.st.Nodes[trackSNode(0)].Status = NodeActive
		if r := submit(t, f, env); r.Code != arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted || len(f.st.Blocks) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("the statement once s0 is Active = %+v, blocks %d", r, len(f.st.Blocks))
		}
	})
	t.Run("lane budget", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, a := tracksFSM(t)
		lanes := tracksUpdate(t, f)
		lanes.ClientLanes = &arbiter.ClientLaneParams{MaxLanesPerAccount: 1}
		mustApply(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, lanes))
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		if r := submit(t, f, trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, testClientLaneA, 1, 1)); r.Code != arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted {
			t.Fatalf("first lane = %+v", r)
		}
		got := refusedOwnerSwitch(t, f, trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, testClientLaneB, 1, 0))
		want := SubmitResult{Code: arbiter.AdmissionCodeLaneBudgetExceeded,
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("account %s already holds 1 client lanes (max_lanes_per_account 1)", account)}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("answer = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
		}
	})
	t.Run("gap budget", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, _ := tracksFSM(t)
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		// accumulator.MaxOpenGapRanges (64) open gap ranges, every statement
		// in indexer 1's open block.
		for seq := uint64(2); seq <= 128; seq += 2 {
			admitTrack(t, f, key, account, seq, 1)
		}
		got := refusedOwnerSwitch(t, f, trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, "", 130, 0))
		want := SubmitResult{Code: arbiter.AdmissionCodeGapBudgetExceeded, Message: accumulator.ErrGapBudgetExceeded.Error()}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("answer = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
		}
		// Continuing from the high-water mark switches owners: the seal the
		// refused attempt prepared left nothing behind.
		if r := submit(t, f, trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, "", 129, 0)); r.Code != arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted {
			t.Fatalf("hi+1 = %+v", r)
		}
		if h := f.st.Blocks[len(f.st.Blocks)-1]; h.Track == nil || h.Track.IndexerID != 1 || h.StatementCount != 64 {
			t.Fatalf("switch seal = %+v, want indexer 1's 64 statements", h)
		}
	})
	t.Run("seal preparation refused", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, _ := tracksFSM(t)
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
		f.st.OpenBlock.Owner = nil // synthesized corruption: a non-empty open block without an owner
		env := trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, "", 2, 0)
		if got := refusedOwnerSwitch(t, f, env); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, Rejected{Reason: "owner switch seal: open block has no owner"}) {
			t.Fatalf("answer = %+v", got)
		}
		owner := uint64(1)
		f.st.OpenBlock.Owner = &owner
		if r := submit(t, f, env); r.Code != arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted {
			t.Fatalf("the refused statement's client_seq must stay unspent: %+v", r)
		}
	})
}

// Spec 2026-10-10 §7.1: an explicit seal after the activation stamps the open
// block's owner as the header's track, and readers get a detached copy.
func TestSealAfterTracksCarriesTheOwnersTrack(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := tracksFSM(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 0)
	admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 2, 0)
	sr := mustSeal(t, f)
	h := f.st.Blocks[sr.BlockSeq-1]
	if h.Track == nil || h.Track.IndexerID != 0 || f.st.OpenBlock.Owner != nil || len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("header track %+v, open block %+v", h.Track, f.st.OpenBlock)
	}
	if hash, err := h.ChainHash(); err != nil || hash != sr.ChainHash {
		t.Fatalf("chain hash %s (%v), seal answered %s", hash, err, sr.ChainHash)
	}
	if b, err := json.Marshal(h); err != nil || !strings.HasSuffix(string(b), `","track":{"indexer_id":0}}`) {
		t.Fatalf("header preimage %s (%v): the track must follow statements_root, written for indexer 0", b, err)
	}
	view, _, _, err := f.L3BlockView(sr.BlockSeq)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	view.Track.IndexerID = 9
	info, ok := f.BlockDispatchInfo(sr.BlockSeq)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("no dispatch info for the sealed block")
	}
	info.Header.Track.IndexerID = 9
	if f.st.Blocks[sr.BlockSeq-1].Track.IndexerID != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a reader's header aliases the committed track")
	}
}

// A non-empty open block without an owner after the activation is local
// corruption; sealing it is refused with state unchanged.
func TestOpenBlockWithoutOwnerIsRefused(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := tracksFSM(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
	f.st.OpenBlock.Owner = nil // synthesized corruption
	rejectTracksUnchanged(t, f, wire.Command{SealL3Block: &wire.SealL3Block{}}, "open block has no owner")
}

// Before the activation statements of both owners share one block, which
// seals without a track, and the open block never records an owner.
func TestSealBeforeTracksCarriesNoTrack(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := tracksReadyFSM(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
	admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 2, 0)
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != 1 || f.st.OpenBlock.Owner != nil || len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("blocks %d, open block %+v: before the activation nothing seals on an owner change", len(f.st.Blocks), f.st.OpenBlock)
	}
	h := f.st.Blocks[mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq-1]
	if b, _ := json.Marshal(h); h.Track != nil || h.StatementCount != 2 || bytes.Contains(b, []byte(`"track"`)) {
		t.Fatalf("pre-activation header %s carries a track", b)
	}
}
```

Create `fsm/determinism_tracks_test.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/hashicorp/raft"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// trackHistory is a recorded raft log across the tracks activation: every
// command is applied to a live FSM to derive the next one, and its encoded
// bytes and answer are kept, so the same log can be replayed on a fresh FSM
// (the replay determinism_source_test.go and determinism_lanes_test.go check).
type trackHistory struct {
	f       *FSM
	params  Params
	log     [][]byte
	answers []any
}

func (h *trackHistory) apply(t *testing.T, c wire.Command) any {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := wire.Encode(c)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("encode: %v", err)
	}
	res := h.f.Apply(&raft.Log{Data: b})
	h.log, h.answers = append(h.log, b), append(h.answers, res)
	return res
}

func (h *trackHistory) must(t *testing.T, c wire.Command) any {
	t.Helper()
	res := h.apply(t, c)
	if r, ok := res.(Rejected); ok {
		t.Fatalf("history command %d rejected: %s", len(h.log), r.Reason)
	}
	return res
}

// ownerSwitchHistory records, from genesis, tracksReadyFSM's history and the
// tracks activation, then statements of indexers 1 and 1, a statement of
// indexer 0 refused with SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE while s0 re-registers (a refused
// owner switch), the same statement admitted once s0 is Active (a switch
// seal), another of indexer 0, one of indexer 1 (a second switch seal) and an
// explicit seal.
func ownerSwitchHistory(t *testing.T) *trackHistory {
	t.Helper()
	a, params := authorityFixture(t)
	h := &trackHistory{f: mustNewFSM(t, params), params: params}
	f := h.f
	enable := registryUpdate(t, f, params, testRegistryParams())
	enable.MaxWriters = 2
	h.must(t, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, enable))
	h.must(t, wire.Command{SeedLegacyTables: &wire.SeedLegacyTables{AtBlock: arbiter.L2BlockRef{Number: 99, Hash: "0x99"}}})
	for _, id := range []string{"s1", "s0", "v1", "v2", "v3"} {
		reg := arbiter.NodeRegistration{NodeID: id, Roles: []arbiter.NodeRole{arbiter.NodeRoleSNode}}
		if id[0] == 'v' {
			reg.Roles, reg.Ed25519Pubkey = []arbiter.NodeRole{arbiter.NodeRoleVerifier}, testPubkey(id[1])
		}
		h.must(t, wire.Command{RegisterNode: &wire.RegisterNode{Registration: reg}})
		h.must(t, wire.Command{MarkActive: &wire.MarkActive{NodeID: id}})
	}
	h.must(t, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, claimsUpdate(t, f,
		[]arbiter.SIIndexerEntry{foundingEntry(t, f), siEntry(t, f, indexerSigner2(t), 0, 150, "s0")}, testVerifiers("v1", "v2", "v3"))))
	h.must(t, advanceTo(149))
	h.must(t, seedIndexerCmd(0, 149))
	h.must(t, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "x", ev(150, "0x150", 0), ev(151, "0x151", 0), 0))
	transition := h.must(t, wire.Command{SealL3Block: &wire.SealL3Block{}}).(SealResult).BlockSeq
	h.must(t, wire.Command{MarkReplaying: &wire.MarkReplaying{BlockSeq: transition}})
	for _, c := range pinnedEvidence(t, f, transition) {
		h.must(t, c)
	}
	h.must(t, wire.Command{RecordAnchorFinality: &wire.RecordAnchorFinality{L3BlockSeq: transition, Anchor: anchorForBlock(t, f, transition),
		FinalityReached: true, LastMergeableReached: true}})
	h.must(t, wire.Command{PublishSafeSnapshot: &wire.PublishSafeSnapshot{Manifest: manifestFromInputs(t, f)}})
	h.must(t, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, tracksUpdate(t, f)))

	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	submitAs := func(seq, owner uint64, want arbiter.AdmissionCode) {
		t.Helper()
		r := h.apply(t, wire.Command{SubmitStatement: &wire.SubmitStatement{Envelope: trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, "", seq, owner)}})
		if sr, ok := r.(SubmitResult); !ok || sr.Code != want {
			t.Fatalf("statement %d of indexer %d = %+v, want code %d", seq, owner, r, want)
		}
	}
	submitAs(1, 1, arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted)
	submitAs(2, 1, arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted)
	h.must(t, snodeRegistration(t, f, indexerSigner2(t), "s0", 1))
	submitAs(3, 0, arbiter.AdmissionCodeSourceUnavailable)
	h.must(t, snodeMarkActive(t, f, indexerSigner2(t), "s0", 1))
	submitAs(3, 0, arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted)
	submitAs(4, 0, arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted)
	submitAs(5, 1, arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted)
	h.must(t, wire.Command{SealL3Block: &wire.SealL3Block{}})
	return h
}

// Review Focus 1: replaying the log on a fresh FSM answers every command the
// same and ends with the same chain hashes and state, owner-switch seals
// inside admission included.
func TestOwnerSwitchSealIsDeterministicAcrossReplay(t *testing.T) {
	h := ownerSwitchHistory(t)
	replica := mustNewFSM(t, h.params)
	for i, b := range h.log {
		if got := replica.Apply(&raft.Log{Data: b}); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, h.answers[i]) {
			t.Fatalf("command %d: the replica answered %+v, the recorded history %+v", i, got, h.answers[i])
		}
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(snapshotBytes(t, h.f), snapshotBytes(t, replica)) || trackStateJSON(t, h.f) != trackStateJSON(t, replica) {
		t.Fatal("replaying the log on a fresh FSM diverged")
	}
	var tracks []string
	for _, hdr := range replica.st.Blocks {
		if hdr.Track == nil {
			tracks = append(tracks, "-")
			continue
		}
		tracks = append(tracks, fmt.Sprint(hdr.Track.IndexerID))
	}
	if got := strings.Join(tracks, ","); got != "-,1,0,1" {
		t.Fatalf("block tracks %s, want -,1,0,1: the pre-activation transition, two owner-switch seals and an explicit seal", got)
	}
}
```

Create `fsm/track_transitions_test.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// Review Focus 3 and spec 2026-10-10 §7.1-§7.2: after the activation a
// transition block carries one owner's changes, each track holds at most one
// unpublished transition block, and a stuck track never holds back another
// owner's change.
func TestOneUnpublishedTransitionPerTrack(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := tracksFSM(t)
	base := f.st.Manifests[f.st.SafeWatermark.SnapshotID]
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "y", ev(152, "0x152", 0), ev(153, "0x153", 0), 0))
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db", "z", ev(154, "0x154", 0), ev(155, "0x155", 0), 1))
	// The lowest owner's change seals first, alone.
	t0 := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	if h := f.st.Blocks[t0-1]; h.Track == nil || h.Track.IndexerID != 0 || len(h.TableSetTransition.Adds) != 1 ||
		h.TableSetTransition.Adds[0].TableID != "db0.y" || len(h.TableSetTransition.Retires) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("first transition = %+v / %+v, want indexer 0's db0.y alone", h.Track, h.TableSetTransition)
	}
	// Indexer 1's change seals although indexer 0's transition is unpublished.
	if !f.TableSetTransitionPending() {
		t.Fatal("indexer 1's change must be sealable while only indexer 0's transition is unpublished")
	}
	t1 := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	if h := f.st.Blocks[t1-1]; h.Track == nil || h.Track.IndexerID != 1 || len(h.TableSetTransition.Adds) != 1 || h.TableSetTransition.Adds[0].TableID != "db.z" {
		t.Fatalf("second transition = %+v / %+v, want indexer 1's db.z alone", h.Track, h.TableSetTransition)
	}
	// Both are pinned to the same published base, and each new_schema_root is
	// judged against it (clarification C1), as verifiers and the anchored
	// root judge it.
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		seq   uint64
		table string
	}{{t0, "db0.y"}, {t1, "db.z"}} {
		h := f.st.Blocks[tc.seq-1]
		set := manifestSchemaSet(base)
		set[tc.table] = f.st.TableRegistry.Live(tc.table).SchemaHash
		if h.PrevSafeSnapshotID != base.SnapshotID || h.TableSetTransition.NewSchemaRoot != payloadexec.SchemaRootFromHashes(set) {
			t.Fatalf("block %d is not pinned to the published base with its own change applied", tc.seq)
		}
		if _, _, _, err := f.pinnedBlockState(tc.seq); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("block %d pinned state: %v", tc.seq, err)
		}
	}
	// Indexer 0's next change waits for indexer 0's own transition only.
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "w", ev(156, "0x156", 0), ev(157, "0x157", 0), 0))
	if want := fmt.Sprintf("table-set transition block %d of indexer 0 is not yet published", t0); f.tableSetTransitionBlockedLocked() != want {
		t.Fatalf("plan = %q, want %q", f.tableSetTransitionBlockedLocked(), want)
	}
	if f.TableSetTransitionPending() || f.TableSetTransitionUnsealable() != "" {
		t.Fatal("a change that only waits is neither pending nor unsealable")
	}
	if r := applyExpectReject(t, f, wire.Command{SealL3Block: &wire.SealL3Block{}}); r.Reason != "open block is empty" {
		t.Fatalf("seal while waiting = %q", r.Reason)
	}
	// Once indexer 0's published frontier covers its transition (a
	// track-aware publication, Task 9; stood in for here), its next change
	// seals while indexer 1's transition is still unpublished.
	setPublishedTrackFrontiers(t, f, replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 0, SafeBlockSeq: t0}, replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 1})
	t2 := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	if h := f.st.Blocks[t2-1]; h.Track == nil || h.Track.IndexerID != 0 || len(h.TableSetTransition.Adds) != 1 || h.TableSetTransition.Adds[0].TableID != "db0.w" {
		t.Fatalf("third transition = %+v / %+v, want indexer 0's db0.w", h.Track, h.TableSetTransition)
	}
}

// Before the activation one transition block carries every owner's changes
// and at most one is unpublished network-wide.
func TestTransitionsBeforeTracksStayGlobal(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := tracksReadyFSM(t)
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "y", ev(152, "0x152", 0), ev(153, "0x153", 0), 0))
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db", "z", ev(154, "0x154", 0), ev(155, "0x155", 0), 1))
	seq := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	if h := f.st.Blocks[seq-1]; h.Track != nil || len(h.TableSetTransition.Adds) != 2 ||
		h.TableSetTransition.Adds[0].TableID != "db.z" || h.TableSetTransition.Adds[1].TableID != "db0.y" {
		t.Fatalf("pre-activation transition = %+v / %+v, want both owners' adds in one block without a track", h.Track, h.TableSetTransition)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db", "w", ev(156, "0x156", 0), ev(157, "0x157", 0), 1))
	if want := fmt.Sprintf("table-set transition block %d is not yet published", seq); f.tableSetTransitionBlockedLocked() != want {
		t.Fatalf("plan = %q, want the global wait %q", f.tableSetTransitionBlockedLocked(), want)
	}
}

// The fence holds while any owner's plan can seal, and
// TableSetTransitionUnsealable names the lowest owner whose change does not
// fit the published base.
func TestTrackTransitionPlanSkipsAnUnsealableOwner(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := tracksFSM(t)
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db", "z", ev(154, "0x154", 0), ev(155, "0x155", 0), 1))
	// Constructed directly, as TestUnsealableTableSetChangeLeavesAdmissionOpen
	// does: indexer 0 retires a table the base lacks.
	zero := uint64(0)

		Status: TableStatusRetiring, Created: ptrRef(ev(152, "0x152", 0)), SchemaRef: ptrRef(ev(153, "0x153", 0)), OwnerIndexerID: &zero})
	if !f.TableSetTransitionPending() {
		t.Fatal("indexer 1's change can seal although indexer 0's cannot")
	}
	seq := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	if h := f.st.Blocks[seq-1]; h.Track == nil || h.Track.IndexerID != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("transition track = %+v, want indexer 1's", h.Track)
	}
	want := `table-set transition of indexer 0: table-set transition retires "db0.ghost", which is not in the base table set`
	if got := f.TableSetTransitionUnsealable(); got != want || f.TableSetTransitionPending() {
		t.Fatalf("unsealable = %q (pending %v), want %q", got, f.TableSetTransitionPending(), want)
	}
	// Nothing can seal now, so admission stays open.
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
}
```

```go
// fillSealedHeaderChainFieldsLocked stamps the chain-continuity fields every
// sealer shares: the predecessor header's chain hash, the safe snapshot the
// block is replayed against, and spentIDsRoot, the spent-IDs root as of the
// seal. The caller passes the root it seals with: the current one, or, for an
// owner-switch seal inside admission, the root before the admitted
// statement's insert (spec 2026-10-10 §7.1, clarification C10). The v2,
// transition and snapshot-query sealers must agree on all four or the chain
// forks, so they are derived in exactly one place.
func (f *FSM) fillSealedHeaderChainFieldsLocked(h *L3BlockHeader, spentIDsRoot string) error {
	base := f.st.Manifests[f.st.SafeWatermark.SnapshotID]
	if base == nil || base.StateRoot == "" {
		return errors.New("genesis safe snapshot must be published before sealing")
	}
	if n := len(f.st.Blocks); n > 0 {
		prev, err := f.st.Blocks[n-1].ChainHash()
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("chain hash: %w", err)
		}
		h.PrevL3Hash = prev
	}
	h.PrevSafeSnapshotID = f.st.SafeWatermark.SnapshotID
	h.PrevStateRoot = base.StateRoot
	h.SpentIDsRootAfter = spentIDsRoot
	return nil
}

// preparedSeal is a statement block sealed in two steps (spec 2026-10-10
// §7.1, clarification C10): prepareStatementSealLocked builds the header and
// proves its chain hash without touching state, and commitSealLocked applies
// it. Between the two calls nothing may change committed state except the
// admitted statement's spent-ids insert, which the header already excludes.
type preparedSeal struct {
	header    L3BlockHeader
	chainHash string
	seqs      []uint64
}

// prepareStatementSealLocked builds the header that seals the non-empty open
// block with spentIDsRoot as its spent_ids_root_after, and mutates nothing.
// After the tracks activation the header carries the open block's owner as
// its track. Its refusal reasons are the ones applySealL3Block has always
// answered, plus the post-activation "open block has no owner".
func (f *FSM) prepareStatementSealLocked(spentIDsRoot string) (*preparedSeal, string) {
	ob := f.st.OpenBlock
	if len(ob.StatementSeqs) == 0 {
		return nil, "open block is empty"
	}
	var track *L3BlockTrack
	if f.tracksActiveLocked() {
		if ob.Owner == nil {
			return nil, "open block has no owner"
		}
		track = &L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: *ob.Owner}
	}
	envs := make([]arbiter.StatementEnvelope, 0, len(ob.StatementSeqs))
	for _, seq := range ob.StatementSeqs {
		ss := f.st.Statements[seq]
		// The admission fence keeps the query lane out of the open block, so
		// this is unreachable; refuse rather than hash a query statement's zero
		// v2 envelope into statements_root if it ever becomes reachable.
		if ss.IsSnapshotQuery() {
			return nil, "query statement in a v2 block"
		}
		envs = append(envs, ss.Env)
	}
	statementsRoot, err := replay.CanonicalDigest(arbiter.DomainL3Statements, envs)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "statements root: " + err.Error()
	}
	hdr := L3BlockHeader{
		L3BlockSeq:        f.st.NextL3BlockSeq,
		StatementSeqStart: ob.StatementSeqStart,
		StatementCount:    uint32(len(ob.StatementSeqs)),
		SchemaSnapshotID:  f.st.Params.SchemaSnapshotID,
		ExecutorProfileID: f.st.Params.ExecutorProfileID,
		StatementsRoot:    statementsRoot,
		Track:             track,
	}
	if err := f.fillSealedHeaderChainFieldsLocked(&hdr, spentIDsRoot); err != nil {
		return nil, err.Error()
	}
	chainHash, err := hdr.ChainHash()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "chain hash: " + err.Error()
	}
	return &preparedSeal{header: hdr, chainHash: chainHash, seqs: slices.Clone(ob.StatementSeqs)}, ""
}

// commitSealLocked applies a prepared seal: it stamps the sealed statements,
// collects the block's source union (sorted, deduped), appends the header and
// its BlockVerification, advances NextL3BlockSeq, opens an empty block without
// an owner at NextStatementSeq and emits EventBlockSealed.
func (f *FSM) commitSealLocked(p *preparedSeal) SealResult {
	hdr := p.header
	srcSet := map[string]bool{}
	for _, seq := range p.seqs {
		ss := f.st.Statements[seq]
		ss.BlockSeq = hdr.L3BlockSeq
		if ss.SourceNode != "" {
			srcSet[ss.SourceNode] = true
		}
	}
	sources := make([]string, 0, len(srcSet))
	for s := range srcSet {
		sources = append(sources, s)
	}
	sort.Strings(sources)
	f.st.Blocks = append(f.st.Blocks, hdr)
	f.st.Verifications[hdr.L3BlockSeq] = &BlockVerification{
		BlockSeq:     hdr.L3BlockSeq,
		SourceNodes:  sources,
		Attestations: map[string]*replay.ReplayAttestation{},
		ByteScans:    map[string]*arbiter.ByteSideScanMsg{},
	}
	f.st.NextL3BlockSeq++
	f.st.OpenBlock = &OpenL3Block{StatementSeqStart: f.st.NextStatementSeq}
	f.emit(Event{Kind: EventBlockSealed, BlockSeq: hdr.L3BlockSeq})
	return SealResult{BlockSeq: hdr.L3BlockSeq, ChainHash: p.chainHash}
}

func (f *FSM) applySealL3Block() any {
	if len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) == 0 {
		// An empty open block seals only as a table-set transition block, and
		// only when the committed registry holds a change it can carry.
		if f.tableSetTransitionBlockedLocked() != "" {
			return Rejected{Reason: "open block is empty"}
		}
		return f.sealTableSetTransitionLocked()
	}
	p, reason := f.prepareStatementSealLocked("0x" + hex.EncodeToString(f.st.SpentIDs.Root()))
	if reason != "" {
		return Rejected{Reason: reason}
	}
	return f.commitSealLocked(p)
}
```
