```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// TestQuarantineRPCsAreRefusedBeforeTheTracksActivation: contract §0. Before
// the activation neither command may reach a voter that predates Raft tags 36
// and 37, so both RPCs answer FailedPrecondition and propose nothing.
func TestQuarantineRPCsAreRefusedBeforeTheTracksActivation(t *testing.T) {
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	activateServerSignedClaims(t, rec.fakeNode, authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex0))
	admin := evictionAdmin(rec, 5*time.Minute)
	ctx := context.Background()
	if _, err := admin.QuarantineIndexer(ctx, quarantineRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 0, "stuck")); status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition ||
		status.Convert(err).Message() != quarantineBeforeTracksMessage {
		t.Fatalf("quarantine before the activation = %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := admin.ReleaseIndexer(ctx, releaseRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1)); status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition ||
		status.Convert(err).Message() != quarantineBeforeTracksMessage {
		t.Fatalf("release before the activation = %v", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a pre-activation quarantine or release was proposed")
	}
}

// TestQuarantineIndexerRPCAfterTheTracksActivation: refusals before proposing
// (a foreign key, a token for another command or another epoch, a malformed
// request), then the full command; the generation is Apply's decision, and
// its refusal reaches the caller as FailedPrecondition carrying the FSM
// reason, not as a leader hint.
func TestQuarantineIndexerRPCAfterTheTracksActivation(t *testing.T) {
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	activateServerTracks(t, rec.fakeNode)
	admin := evictionAdmin(rec, 5*time.Minute)
	ctx := context.Background()
	if _, err := admin.QuarantineIndexer(ctx, quarantineRequest(t, rec.f, authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex1), 2, 0, "stuck")); status.Code(err) != codes.PermissionDenied {
		t.Fatalf("a non-authority key = %v", err)
	}
	other := quarantineRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 2, 0, "another reason")
	other.Reason = "stuck"
	if _, err := admin.QuarantineIndexer(ctx, other); status.Code(err) != codes.PermissionDenied {
		t.Fatalf("a token for another command = %v", err)
	}
	nextEpoch := serverAuthorityContext(t, rec.f)
	nextEpoch.AuthorityEpoch++
	token, err := serverTestAuthority.SignQuarantineIndexerWithContext(arbiter.QuarantineIndexerCommand{IndexerID: 2, Reason: "stuck"}, nextEpoch)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := admin.QuarantineIndexer(ctx, &pb.QuarantineIndexerCmd{IndexerId: 2, Reason: "stuck", AuthorityJws: token}); status.Code(err) != codes.PermissionDenied {
		t.Fatalf("a token bound to another epoch = %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := admin.QuarantineIndexer(ctx, &pb.QuarantineIndexerCmd{IndexerId: 2, Reason: "  ", AuthorityJws: "a.b.c"}); status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument {
		t.Fatalf("an empty reason = %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := admin.QuarantineIndexer(ctx, &pb.QuarantineIndexerCmd{IndexerId: 2, Reason: "stuck", AuthorityJws: "not-a-jws"}); status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument {
		t.Fatalf("a malformed token = %v", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a refused quarantine was proposed")
	}
	req := quarantineRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 2, 0, "stuck")
	if _, err := admin.QuarantineIndexer(ctx, req); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("authority quarantine = %v", err)
	}
	lastProposalIs(t, rec, wire.Command{QuarantineIndexer: &wire.QuarantineIndexer{IndexerID: 2, ExpectedGeneration: 0, Reason: "stuck", AuthorityJWS: req.GetAuthorityJws()}})
	if v := rec.f.TrackStateView(); !v.Indexers[1].Quarantined || v.Indexers[1].QuarantineGeneration != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("indexer 2 after the quarantine: %+v", v.Indexers[1])
	}
	_, err = admin.QuarantineIndexer(ctx, quarantineRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 2, 0, "stuck"))
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || isNotLeader(err) ||
		!strings.Contains(status.Convert(err).Message(), "expected_generation 0 differs from quarantine generation 1 of indexer 2") {
		t.Fatalf("a replayed quarantine = %v", err)
	}
}

// TestReleaseIndexerRPCAfterTheTracksActivation: the acknowledged list must be
// strictly ascending before anything else is checked; it must equal the
// track's rejected blocks exactly, which Apply decides; a release applies and
// bumps the generation.
func TestReleaseIndexerRPCAfterTheTracksActivation(t *testing.T) {
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	activateServerTracks(t, rec.fakeNode)
	mustDirectApply(t, rec.fakeNode, quarantineCommand(t, rec.f, 2, 0, "stuck"))
	admin := evictionAdmin(rec, 5*time.Minute)
	ctx := context.Background()
	for name, list := range map[string][]uint64{"descending": {7, 5}, "duplicated": {5, 5}} {
		_, err := admin.ReleaseIndexer(ctx, releaseRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 2, 1, list...))
		if status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument || status.Convert(err).Message() != "acknowledged_rejected_blocks must be strictly ascending" {
			t.Fatalf("%s list = %v", name, err)
		}
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a malformed release was proposed")
	}
	_, err := admin.ReleaseIndexer(ctx, releaseRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 2, 1, 5))
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || !strings.Contains(status.Convert(err).Message(), "release must acknowledge exactly the rejected blocks") {
		t.Fatalf("a release acknowledging a block the track never rejected = %v", err)
	}
	req := releaseRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 2, 1)
	if _, err := admin.ReleaseIndexer(ctx, req); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("authority release = %v", err)
	}
	lastProposalIs(t, rec, wire.Command{ReleaseIndexer: &wire.ReleaseIndexer{IndexerID: 2, ExpectedGeneration: 1, AuthorityJWS: req.GetAuthorityJws()}})
	if v := rec.f.TrackStateView(); v.Indexers[1].Quarantined || v.Indexers[1].QuarantineGeneration != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("indexer 2 after the release: %+v", v.Indexers[1])
	}
}

// TestQuarantineRPCKeepsEvictNodesCheckOrder: contract §3.8. Each request
// fails several checks and reports the earliest in EvictNode's order: updates
// enabled, the tracks activation, shape, leadership, authority, token age.
func TestQuarantineRPCKeepsEvictNodesCheckOrder(t *testing.T) {
	before := newRecordingNode(t)
	after := newRecordingNode(t)
	activateServerTracks(t, after.fakeNode)
	follower := &recordingNode{fakeNode: &fakeNode{f: after.f}}
	malformed := &pb.QuarantineIndexerCmd{IndexerId: 2, AuthorityJws: "not-a-jws"}
	foreign := quarantineRequest(t, after.f, authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex1), 2, 0, "stuck")
	valid := quarantineRequest(t, after.f, serverTestAuthority, 2, 0, "stuck")
	disabled := &consensusAdminService{s: New(Deps{Node: before, FSM: before.f, Cfg: Config{NodeID: "arb-0", ApplyTimeout: time.Second}})}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name    string
		admin   *consensusAdminService
		req     *pb.QuarantineIndexerCmd
		code    codes.Code
		message string
	}{
		{"updates disabled first", disabled, malformed, codes.FailedPrecondition, consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage},
		{"the activation before shape", evictionAdmin(before, 5*time.Minute), malformed, codes.FailedPrecondition, quarantineBeforeTracksMessage},
		{"shape before leadership", evictionAdmin(follower, 5*time.Minute), malformed, codes.InvalidArgument, "reason is required"},
		{"leadership before authority", evictionAdmin(follower, 5*time.Minute), foreign, codes.FailedPrecondition, "not the leader"},
		{"authority", evictionAdmin(after, 5*time.Minute), foreign, codes.PermissionDenied, "indexer quarantine authority"},
		{"token age fails closed", evictionAdmin(after, 0), valid, codes.PermissionDenied, "indexer quarantine authority"},
	} {
		_, err := tc.admin.QuarantineIndexer(context.Background(), tc.req)
		if status.Code(err) != tc.code || !strings.Contains(status.Convert(err).Message(), tc.message) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v, want %v containing %q", tc.name, err, tc.code, tc.message)
		}
	}
	if before.proposals()+after.proposals()+follower.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a refused request was proposed")
	}
}

// TestGetTrackStateIsABarrieredRead: contract §3.8. The view crosses the
// leader barrier like GetConsensusParams: empty before the activation, every
// enrolled indexer afterwards (sorted, with its quarantine state), NotLeader
// on a follower.
func TestGetTrackStateIsABarrieredRead(t *testing.T) {
	state := newServerTestFSM(t)
	var barriers atomic.Int32
	conn, _, node := startServerWithConfig(t, startServerConfig{f: state, leader: true,
		configureNode: func(n *fakeNode) { n.barrier = func(time.Duration) error { barriers.Add(1); return nil } }})
	publishServerGenesis(t, node)
	client := pb.NewConsensusAdminClient(conn)
	got, err := client.GetTrackState(t.Context(), &emptypb.Empty{})
	if err != nil || !proto.Equal(got, &pb.TrackStateView{}) || barriers.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("before the activation GetTrackState = %v, %v (barriers %d)", got, err, barriers.Load())
	}
	activateServerTracks(t, node)
	mustDirectApply(t, node, quarantineCommand(t, state, 2, 0, "stuck"))
	got, err = client.GetTrackState(t.Context(), &emptypb.Empty{})
	want := &pb.TrackStateView{TracksEnabled: true, Indexers: []*pb.IndexerTrackView{
		{IndexerId: 1, Initial: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 1}, Published: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 1}},
		{IndexerId: 2, Initial: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 2}, Published: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 2},
			QuarantineGeneration: 1, Quarantined: true, QuarantineReason: "stuck"},
	}}
	if err != nil || !proto.Equal(got, want) || barriers.Load() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("after the activation GetTrackState = %v, %v (barriers %d)\nwant %v", got, err, barriers.Load(), want)
	}
	followerConn, _, _ := startServerWithConfig(t, startServerConfig{f: state, leader: false})
	if _, err := pb.NewConsensusAdminClient(followerConn).GetTrackState(t.Context(), &emptypb.Empty{}); !isNotLeader(err) {
		t.Fatalf("follower GetTrackState = %v, want NotLeader", err)
	}
}
```

```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// TestTracksActivationNeedsEveryDataPlaneNodeInTheFeatureBook: contract §3.8.
// The leader refuses the tracks activation before proposing while a
// registered data-plane node has not advertised track_manifests_v1 to it in
// this term, reads after a barrier, and accepts once the node re-registers on
// a stage-2 binary.
func TestTracksActivationNeedsEveryDataPlaneNodeInTheFeatureBook(t *testing.T) {
	vn := newVoterNode(t, "arb-0")
	barriers := 0
	vn.barrier = func(time.Duration) error { barriers++; return nil }
	s := gateServer(vn)
	prepareTracksGate(t, s, vn, arbiter.ClientLanesFeature, arbiter.SignedClaimsFeature) // s1 still runs a stage-1 binary
	admin := &consensusAdminService{s: s}
	ctx := context.Background()
	before, barriersBefore := vn.appliedCount(), barriers
	_, err := admin.UpdateConsensusParams(ctx, serverTracksActivationRequest(t, vn.fakeNode))
	const want = "tracks gate refused: data-plane nodes s1 have not registered with this leader advertising track_manifests_v1; restart them on a stage-2 release"
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != want {
		t.Fatalf("activation with a stage-1 SNode = %v", err)
	}
	if vn.appliedCount() != before || vn.f.TracksActive() {
		t.Fatal("the refused activation was proposed")
	}
	if barriers == barriersBefore {
		t.Fatal("the tracks gate read applied state without a barrier")
	}
	founder := authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex0)
	if _, err := (&membershipService{s: s}).RegisterNode(ctx, signedSNodeRegistration(t, vn.f, founder, "s1", 1760000000000, arbiter.LocalNodeFeatures()...)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("s1 re-registers on a stage-2 binary: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := admin.UpdateConsensusParams(ctx, serverTracksActivationRequest(t, vn.fakeNode)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("activation once every node advertises track_manifests_v1 = %v", err)
	}
	if !vn.f.TracksActive() {
		t.Fatal("tracks not active")
	}
}

// TestTracksGateRefusesWhileANonVoterExists: a non-voter applies every
// command but no gate can prove it runs a stage-2 build.
func TestTracksGateRefusesWhileANonVoterExists(t *testing.T) {
	vn := newVoterNode(t, "arb-0")
	vn.nonvoters = []string{"arb-7"}
	s := gateServer(vn)
	prepareTracksGate(t, s, vn, arbiter.LocalNodeFeatures()...)
	before := vn.appliedCount()
	_, err := (&consensusAdminService{s: s}).UpdateConsensusParams(context.Background(), serverTracksActivationRequest(t, vn.fakeNode))
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "tracks gate refused") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "arb-7") {
		t.Fatalf("activation with a non-voter = %v", err)
	}
	if vn.appliedCount() != before {
		t.Fatal("the refused activation was proposed")
	}
}

// TestTracksGateRefusesWithTheFSMActivationReason: contract §3.8. The gate
// answers with the FSM's own activation refusal, here a statement waiting in
// the open block, and checks it before the feature book: s1 has not
// advertised track_manifests_v1 either, yet the answer names the FSM reason.
func TestTracksGateRefusesWithTheFSMActivationReason(t *testing.T) {
	vn := newVoterNode(t, "arb-0")
	s := gateServer(vn)
	prepareTracksGate(t, s, vn, arbiter.ClientLanesFeature, arbiter.SignedClaimsFeature)
	genesis, ok := vn.f.ManifestBySafeBlock(0)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("genesis manifest missing")
	}
	key, account := testAccount(t)
	iat := time.Now().Unix()
	env := signEnvelope(t, key, account, 1, iat)
	env.SchemaHash = genesis.Tables[0].SchemaHash
	env.UserJWS = signStatementEnvelopeAt(t, key, env, iat)
	mustDirectApply(t, vn.fakeNode, wire.Command{SubmitStatement: &wire.SubmitStatement{Envelope: env}})
	if vn.f.OpenBlockStats().Count != 1 {
		t.Fatal("the statement was not admitted")
	}
	before := vn.appliedCount()
	_, err := (&consensusAdminService{s: s}).UpdateConsensusParams(context.Background(), serverTracksActivationRequest(t, vn.fakeNode))
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != "tracks gate refused: tracks activation requires an empty open block" {
		t.Fatalf("activation with a statement in the open block = %v", err)
	}
	if vn.appliedCount() != before {
		t.Fatal("the refused activation was proposed")
	}
}

// TestTracksGateRunsOnlyForTheActivation: an update that does not set
// tracks_enabled, and every update after the activation, skips the gate:
// here a non-voter and a stage-1 SNode in the book refuse nothing.
func TestTracksGateRunsOnlyForTheActivation(t *testing.T) {

		t.Fatalf("an update after the activation = %v", err)
	}

	if err != nil || view.Current.MaxWriters != 3 || !view.Current.TracksEnabled {
		t.Fatalf("view after both updates: %+v, %v", view.Current, err)
	}
}

// TestRegistrationCannotSlipBetweenTheTracksGateAndItsProposal: the tracks
// activation holds membershipMu exclusively from its barrier through its
// proposal, so a stage-1 registration issued meanwhile runs only after the
// activation committed, where the gateway refuses it before proposing.
func TestRegistrationCannotSlipBetweenTheTracksGateAndItsProposal(t *testing.T) {
	vn := newVoterNode(t, "arb-0")
	node := &hookedVoterNode{voterNode: vn}
	s := New(Deps{Node: node, FSM: vn.f, Cfg: Config{NodeID: "arb-0", ApplyTimeout: time.Second,
		ConsensusUpdatesEnabled: true, ConsensusAdminMaxTokenAge: 5 * time.Minute}})
	prepareTracksGate(t, s, vn, arbiter.LocalNodeFeatures()...)
	m := &membershipService{s: s}
	registered := make(chan error, 1)
	var once sync.Once
	node.beforeApply = func(cmd wire.Command) {
		if cmd.UpdateConsensusParams == nil || !cmd.UpdateConsensusParams.Update.TracksEnabled {
			return
		}
		once.Do(func() {
			go func() {
				_, err := m.RegisterNode(context.Background(), verifierRequest("v4", 4, arbiter.ClientLanesFeature, arbiter.SignedClaimsFeature))
				registered <- err
			}()
			select {
			case err := <-registered:
				registered <- err
			case <-time.After(500 * time.Millisecond):
			}
		})
	}
	if _, err := (&consensusAdminService{s: s}).UpdateConsensusParams(context.Background(), serverTracksActivationRequest(t, vn.fakeNode)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("activation: %v", err)
	}
	err := <-registered
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != "tracks are active; this binary does not support track-aware manifests" {
		t.Fatalf("the concurrent stage-1 registration = %v, want the post-activation refusal", err)
	}
	node.mu.Lock()
	order := slices.Clone(node.order)
	node.mu.Unlock()
	if slices.Contains(order, "register v4") {
		t.Fatalf("apply order %v: the stage-1 registration reached the log", order)
	}
}

}
```

```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"slices"
	"testing"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// l3HeaderWithTrackFromPB is l3HeaderFromPB (safestate_l3block_wire_test.go,
// whose frozen goldens predate tracks) that also reads the track.
func l3HeaderWithTrackFromPB(m *pb.L3BlockHeader) fsm.L3BlockHeader {
	h := l3HeaderFromPB(m)
	if tr := m.GetTrack(); tr != nil {
		h.Track = &fsm.L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: tr.GetIndexerId()}
	}
	return h
}

// TestL3HeaderWireFormCarriesTheTrack: GetL3Block copies the header's track
// (proto field 14; TestL3BlockHeaderMirrorsProto pins the tag), with message
// presence keeping indexer 0 distinct from absent, so an auditor recomputes a
// tracked block's chain hash from the proto alone; an untracked header sends
// no track and hashes exactly as before.
func TestL3HeaderWireFormCarriesTheTrack(t *testing.T) {
	base := fsm.L3BlockHeader{L3BlockSeq: 7, PrevL3Hash: "0xprev", StatementSeqStart: 12, StatementCount: 1, SchemaSnapshotID: "schema-1",
		ExecutorProfileID: "housegate-replay-mvp-v0", PrevSafeSnapshotID: "snap-6", PrevStateRoot: "0xroot", SpentIDsRootAfter: "0xspent",
		StatementsRoot: "0x26a84c5328ee91532616e484b62ad262476ae476949cbf9f325a89e6463d1049"}
	zero, one := base, base
	zero.Track = &fsm.L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 0}
	one.Track = &fsm.L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 1}
	if l3HeaderToPB(base).GetTrack() != nil {
		t.Fatal("an untracked header sent a track")
	}
	hashes := map[string]string{}
	for name, h := range map[string]fsm.L3BlockHeader{"untracked": base, "indexer 0": zero, "indexer 1": one} {
		raw, err := proto.Marshal(l3HeaderToPB(h))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var decoded pb.L3BlockHeader
		if err := proto.Unmarshal(raw, &decoded); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		want, err := h.ChainHash()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got, err := l3HeaderWithTrackFromPB(&decoded).ChainHash()
		if err != nil || got != want {
			t.Fatalf("%s: chain hash from proto = %s (%v), fsm %s", name, got, err, want)
		}
		if other, dup := hashes[want]; dup {
			t.Fatalf("%s and %s hash alike", name, other)
		}
		hashes[want] = name
	}
}

// TestGetL3BlockServesATrackedBlock: a block sealed after the tracks
// activation reaches the auditor with its track (here indexer 2's transition
// block), and its chain hash recomputes from the reply.
func TestGetL3BlockServesATrackedBlock(t *testing.T) {
	state := newServerTestFSM(t)
	node := &fakeNode{f: state, leader: true}
	publishServerGenesis(t, node)
	activateServerTracks(t, node)
	addServerTableOfIndexer2(t, node)
	got, err := (&safeStateService{s: New(Deps{Node: node, FSM: state})}).GetL3Block(t.Context(), &pb.L3BlockRef{L3BlockSeq: 1})
	if err != nil || got.GetHeader().GetTrack() == nil || got.GetHeader().GetTrack().GetIndexerId() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("GetL3Block(1) = %v, %v", got.GetHeader(), err)
	}
	if h, err := l3HeaderWithTrackFromPB(got.GetHeader()).ChainHash(); err != nil || h != got.GetChainHash() {
		t.Fatalf("recomputed chain hash = %s (%v), reply %s", h, err, got.GetChainHash())
	}
}

// TestTableRegistryServesQuarantinedIndexers: contract §3.8. The registry read
// API carries the quarantined set (field 9), empty until a quarantine, and a
// quarantine and a release reach open watchers as new versions.
func TestTableRegistryServesQuarantinedIndexers(t *testing.T) {
	state := newServerTestFSM(t)
	conn, _, node := startServerWithConfig(t, startServerConfig{f: state, leader: true})
	publishServerGenesis(t, node)

	client := pb.NewTableRegistryClient(conn)

	if err != nil || len(got.GetQuarantinedIndexers()) != 0 {

	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	watch, err := client.WatchTableRegistry(ctx, &pb.WatchTableRegistryRequest{SinceVersion: got.GetVersion()})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustDirectApply(t, node, quarantineCommand(t, state, 2, 0, "stuck"))
	snap, err := watch.Recv()
	if err != nil || snap.GetVersion() <= got.GetVersion() || !slices.Equal(snap.GetQuarantinedIndexers(), []uint64{2}) {
		t.Fatalf("watched snapshot after the quarantine: version %d, quarantined %v, %v", snap.GetVersion(), snap.GetQuarantinedIndexers(), err)
	}
	mustDirectApply(t, node, releaseCommand(t, state, 2, 1))
	got, err = client.GetTableRegistry(t.Context(), &emptypb.Empty{})
	if err != nil || len(got.GetQuarantinedIndexers()) != 0 || got.GetVersion() <= snap.GetVersion() {
		t.Fatalf("after the release: version %d, quarantined %v, %v", got.GetVersion(), got.GetQuarantinedIndexers(), err)
	}
}
```

`server/signed_messages.go` — append after `EvictNode`:

```go
// consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage is the refusal of a ConsensusAdmin mutation
// while consensus_updates_enabled is false (EvictNode's wording).
const consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage = "consensus parameter updates are disabled; verify every voter's protocol capability before setting consensus_updates_enabled: true"

// quarantineBeforeTracksMessage refuses QuarantineIndexer and ReleaseIndexer
// before the tracks activation (contract §0): Raft tags 36 and 37 would reach
// voters that refuse them at decode. Apply refuses with the same reason.
const quarantineBeforeTracksMessage = "quarantine requires the tracks activation"

// QuarantineIndexer quarantines one SI indexer on an authority-signed request
// (housegate spec 2026-10-10 §7.4, contract §3.8): its track issues no new
// work and admission answers INDEXER_QUARANTINED for its tables until a
// release. It keeps EvictNode's order and reasons: nothing on this path
// writes to the log before the checks, leadership is verified rather than
// barriered, the token age is decided here because Apply may not read the
// clock, and Apply re-verifies the token and decides the generation
// atomically. A refusal from Apply names committed state (the generation, a
// quarantine already in force), so it reaches the caller as
// FailedPrecondition with the FSM's reason.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) QuarantineIndexer(ctx context.Context, req *pb.QuarantineIndexerCmd) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	if !svc.s.d.Cfg.ConsensusUpdatesEnabled {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage)
	}
	if !svc.s.d.FSM.TracksActive() {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, quarantineBeforeTracksMessage)
	}
	cmd := wire.QuarantineIndexerFromRequest(req)
	switch {
	case strings.TrimSpace(cmd.Reason) == "":
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "reason is required")
	case len(strings.Split(cmd.AuthorityJWS, ".")) != 3:
		// A token that is not a JWS is a malformed request, not a failed
		// authorization.
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "authority_jws must be a JWS compact serialization with 3 dot-separated parts")
	}
	consensus, validator, err := svc.quarantineAuthority(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := validator.AuthorizeQuarantineIndexer(cmd.Canonical(), cmd.AuthorityJWS, consensus); err != nil {
		// The validator names the recovered address or the failed check and
		// never the token itself; keep it that way.
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "indexer quarantine authority: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := svc.s.propose(ctx, wire.Command{QuarantineIndexer: &cmd}); err != nil {
		return nil, applyRefusalAsFailedPrecondition(err)
	}
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

// ReleaseIndexer releases a quarantined SI indexer on an authority-signed
// request (spec §7.4, §7.5, contract §3.8). The acknowledged rejected blocks
// must be strictly ascending, as the token signs them; Apply requires them to
// equal the track's rejected blocks exactly. Otherwise QuarantineIndexer's
// order and reasons apply.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) ReleaseIndexer(ctx context.Context, req *pb.ReleaseIndexerCmd) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	if !svc.s.d.Cfg.ConsensusUpdatesEnabled {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage)
	}
	if !svc.s.d.FSM.TracksActive() {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, quarantineBeforeTracksMessage)
	}
	cmd := wire.ReleaseIndexerFromRequest(req)
	switch {
	case !strictlyAscending(req.GetAcknowledgedRejectedBlocks()):
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "acknowledged_rejected_blocks must be strictly ascending")
	case len(strings.Split(cmd.AuthorityJWS, ".")) != 3:
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "authority_jws must be a JWS compact serialization with 3 dot-separated parts")
	}
	consensus, validator, err := svc.quarantineAuthority(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := validator.AuthorizeReleaseIndexer(cmd.Canonical(), cmd.AuthorityJWS, consensus); err != nil {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "indexer release authority: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := svc.s.propose(ctx, wire.Command{ReleaseIndexer: &cmd}); err != nil {
		return nil, applyRefusalAsFailedPrecondition(err)
	}
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

// quarantineAuthority confirms leadership (no log write) and returns what both
// quarantine RPCs verify their token against: this leader's committed
// {network, genesis, epoch} and authority set, with the configured token age.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) quarantineAuthority(ctx context.Context) (authority.ConsensusContext, authority.Validator, error) {
	if err := svc.s.consensusLeaderCheck(ctx); err != nil {
		return authority.ConsensusContext{}, authority.Validator{}, err
	}
	view, err := svc.s.d.FSM.ConsensusParamsView()
	if err != nil {
		return authority.ConsensusContext{}, authority.Validator{}, status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "consensus parameters unavailable: %v", err)
	}
	return authority.ConsensusContext{NetworkID: view.Current.NetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID: view.GenesisSnapshotID, AuthorityEpoch: view.Epoch},
		authority.Validator{AllowedAddresses: authorityAddressSet(view.Current.AuthorityAddresses), MaxTokenAge: svc.s.d.Cfg.ConsensusAdminMaxTokenAge},
		nil
}

// applyRefusalAsFailedPrecondition maps propose's InvalidArgument, which is
// exactly fsm.Rejected (server.go), to FailedPrecondition with the same
// reason (contract §3.8). Every other error passes unchanged.
func applyRefusalAsFailedPrecondition(err error) error {
	if st, ok := status.FromError(err); ok && st.Code() == codes.InvalidArgument {
		return status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, st.Message())
	}
	return err
}

// strictlyAscending reports a sorted list without duplicates.
func strictlyAscending(list []uint64) bool {
	for i := 1; i < len(list); i++ {
		if list[i] <= list[i-1] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
```

```go
// GetTrackState is the operator's linearizable read of the tracks state
// (contract §3.8): it crosses the leader barrier like GetConsensusParams, so a
// follower answers NotLeader. Before the tracks activation tracks_enabled is
// false and no indexer is listed.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) GetTrackState(ctx context.Context, _ *emptypb.Empty) (*pb.TrackStateView, error) {
	if err := svc.s.consensusReadBarrier(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return trackStateToPB(svc.s.d.FSM.TrackStateView()), nil
}

func trackStateToPB(v fsm.TrackStateView) *pb.TrackStateView {
	out := &pb.TrackStateView{
		TracksEnabled:         v.TracksEnabled,
		CutoverBlockSeq:       v.CutoverBlockSeq,
		CutoverPromotionSeq:   v.CutoverPromotionSeq,
		GlobalSafeBlockSeq:    v.GlobalSafeBlockSeq,
		PublishedSafeBlockSeq: v.PublishedSafeBlockSeq,
	}
	for _, ix := range v.Indexers {
		out.Indexers = append(out.Indexers, &pb.IndexerTrackView{
			IndexerId:                  ix.IndexerID,
			Initial:                    trackFrontierToPB(ix.Initial),
			QuarantineGeneration:       ix.QuarantineGeneration,
			Quarantined:                ix.Quarantined,
			QuarantineReason:           ix.QuarantineReason,
			RejectedBlocks:             slices.Clone(ix.RejectedBlocks),
			AcknowledgedRejectedBlocks: slices.Clone(ix.AcknowledgedRejectedBlocks),
			PrefixBlockSeq:             ix.PrefixBlockSeq,
			Published:                  trackFrontierToPB(ix.Published),
		})
	}
	return out
}

func trackFrontierToPB(f replay.TrackFrontier) *pb.TrackFrontier {
	return &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: f.IndexerID, SafeBlockSeq: f.SafeBlockSeq, AppliedPromotionSeq: f.AppliedPromotionSeq}
}
```

```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
)

// tracksGate is the leader-local half of the tracks activation gate (housegate
// spec 2026-10-10 §7.6, contract §3.8), the signed-claims gate's pattern
// reused. An update that first sets tracks_enabled is refused unless the Raft
// configuration has no non-voter, which no gate could vouch for; the FSM's
// own activation preconditions hold on this leader's applied state (the open
// block empty, every sealed block safe and published, artifact disposition
// capability 0, the snapshot-query barrier idle: FSM.TracksActivationRefusal,
// which Apply decides again); and every registered, non-evicted SNode and
// verifier advertised track_manifests_v1 in a registration applied through
// this leader in the current term, so no data-plane node is handed a
// track-aware manifest it cannot read. The voter half, every voter reporting
// track_manifests_v1 through its own GetProtocolInfo, runs in arbiter-admin.
// Node features are never replicated, so this is an admission decision only.
func (s *Server) tracksGate(ctx context.Context, update arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) error {
	if !update.TracksEnabled || s.d.FSM.TracksActive() {
		return nil
	}
	membership, ok := s.d.Node.(raftMembership)
	if !ok {
		return status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, "tracks gate refused: raft configuration is unavailable on this node")
	}
	terms, ok := s.d.Node.(termReader)
	if !ok {
		return status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, "tracks gate refused: raft term is unavailable on this node")
	}
	_, nonvoters, err := membership.RaftServerIDs()
	if err != nil {
		return status.Errorf(codes.Unavailable, "tracks gate: read raft configuration: %v", err)
	}
	if len(nonvoters) > 0 {
		return status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "tracks gate refused: raft configuration has non-voting servers %s; promote or remove them first", strings.Join(nonvoters, ", "))
	}
	if reason := s.d.FSM.TracksActivationRefusal(); reason != "" {
		return status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "tracks gate refused: %s", reason)
	}
	term := terms.CurrentTerm()
	var missing []string
	for _, id := range s.d.FSM.PurgeNodeSet() {
		if e, ok := s.features.answer(id, term); !ok || !slices.Contains(e.features, arbiter.TrackManifestsFeature) {
			missing = append(missing, id)
		}
	}
	if len(missing) > 0 {
		return status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "tracks gate refused: data-plane nodes %s have not registered with this leader advertising %s; restart them on a stage-2 release",
			strings.Join(missing, ", "), arbiter.TrackManifestsFeature)
	}
	return nil
}

// tracksCommitted reports whether the tracks activation is committed, for a
// gateway that must not propose a stage-2 field before it (contract §0). Like
// clientLanesCommitted it answers a yes from applied state and a no only
// after a read barrier: a new leader that has not applied the activation yet
// would otherwise refuse a field it may already propose.
func (s *Server) tracksCommitted(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
	if s.d.FSM.TracksActive() {
		return true, nil
	}
	if err := s.consensusReadBarrier(ctx); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return s.d.FSM.TracksActive(), nil
}
```

```go
// rejectedCleanupAckBeforeTracksMessage refuses a cleanup acknowledgement
// carrying rejected_block_seq before the tracks activation (contract §0).
const rejectedCleanupAckBeforeTracksMessage = "cleanup ack rejected_block_seq requires the tracks activation"

func (svc *promotionGatewayService) AckCleanup(ctx context.Context, ack *pb.CleanupAck) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	// A rejected-part cleanup exists only after the tracks activation
	// (clarification C4). Before it the field would reach voters that refuse
	// it at decode, so the leader refuses it without proposing.
	if ack.GetRejectedBlockSeq() != 0 {
		active, err := svc.s.tracksCommitted(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !active {
			return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, rejectedCleanupAckBeforeTracksMessage)
		}
	}
	record := wire.RecordCleanupAckFromRequest(ack)
	res, err := svc.s.propose(ctx, svc.s.signedClaimsCommand(wire.Command{RecordCleanupAck: &record}))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, ok := res.(fsm.Applied); !ok {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "unexpected cleanup ack result %T", res)
	}
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}
```

```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ecdsa"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// manualWindows replaces the grouper's timer: a window closes only when the
// test calls closeNext.
type manualWindows struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	opened  []time.Duration
	pending []func()
}

// manualTimer is the handle of a window manualWindows closes by hand.
type manualTimer struct{}

func (manualTimer) Stop() bool { return true }

func (w *manualWindows) afterFunc(d time.Duration, f func()) groupingTimer {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	w.opened = append(w.opened, d)
	w.pending = append(w.pending, f)
	return manualTimer{}
}

// closeNext runs the oldest pending window close.
func (w *manualWindows) closeNext(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	w.mu.Lock()
	if len(w.pending) == 0 {
		w.mu.Unlock()
		t.Fatal("no grouping window is open")
	}
	f := w.pending[0]
	w.pending = w.pending[1:]
	w.mu.Unlock()
	f()
}

// windows lists the durations of the windows opened so far.
func (w *manualWindows) windows() []time.Duration {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(w.opened)
}

// groupingNode is recordingNode that reports leadership the way
// raftnode.Node.IsLeader does, so the grouping window engages.
type groupingNode struct {
	*recordingNode
	follower bool
}

func (n *groupingNode) IsLeader() bool { return !n.follower }

// groupingServer is a leader after the tracks activation (indexers 1 and 2,
// activateServerTracks) with db.b Pending under indexer 2 and its transition
// block sealed (addServerTableOfIndexer2), a 50ms grouping window whose
// windows the test closes by hand, and a node that records every proposal.
func groupingServer(t *testing.T) (*Server, *groupingNode, *manualWindows) {
	t.Helper()
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	activateServerTracks(t, rec.fakeNode)
	addServerTableOfIndexer2(t, rec.fakeNode)
	node := &groupingNode{recordingNode: rec}
	s := New(Deps{Node: node, FSM: rec.f, LeaderAddr: func() string { return "leader-addr:7001" },
		Cfg: Config{NodeID: "arb-0", ApplyTimeout: time.Second, MaxStatementAge: time.Hour, SubmissionGroupingWindow: 50 * time.Millisecond}})
	t.Cleanup(s.Close)
	windows := &manualWindows{}
	s.grouper.afterFunc = windows.afterFunc
	return s, node, windows
}

type submitOutcome struct {
	ack *pb.SequencedAck
	err error
}

// heldSubmit starts SubmitStatement for env and returns once the grouper
// holds it as the n-th submission of the open window, so arrival order is
// call order.
func heldSubmit(t *testing.T, s *Server, env arbiter.StatementEnvelope, n int) <-chan submitOutcome {
	t.Helper()
	out := make(chan submitOutcome, 1)
	go func() {
		ack, err := (&ingressService{s: s}).SubmitStatement(context.Background(), pbEnvelope(env))
		out <- submitOutcome{ack, err}
	}()
	waitHeld(t, s.grouper, n)
	return out
}

// waitHeld waits until the open window holds n submissions.
func waitHeld(t *testing.T, g *submissionGrouper, n int) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
	for {
		g.mu.Lock()
		held := len(g.held)
		g.mu.Unlock()
		if held == n {
			return
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("the grouper holds %d submissions, want %d", held, n)
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// tableEnvelope is account's statement seq into table under schemaHash,
// signed now (signEnvelope's db.t envelope, retargeted).
func tableEnvelope(t *testing.T, key *ecdsa.PrivateKey, account string, seq uint64, table, schemaHash string) arbiter.StatementEnvelope {
	t.Helper()
	iat := time.Now().Unix()
	env := signEnvelope(t, key, account, seq, iat)
	env.TargetTableID, env.SchemaHash = table, schemaHash
	env.UserJWS = signStatementEnvelopeAt(t, key, env, iat)
	return env
}

// proposedSubmissions lists "<target table>#<client seq>" for every proposed
// SubmitStatement, in log order.
func proposedSubmissions(n *recordingNode) []string {
	n.mu.Lock()
	defer n.mu.Unlock()
	var out []string
	for _, cmd := range n.proposed {
		if sub := cmd.GetSubmitStatement(); sub != nil {
			out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("%s#%d", sub.GetEnvelope().GetTargetTableId(), sub.GetEnvelope().GetStatementId().GetClientSeq()))
		}
	}
	return out
}

// TestOrderByOwner: the window's proposal order (contract §3.8): owners in
// the order of their first held submission, arrival order within an owner,
// unresolvable tables last; indexer 0 is an owner like any other.
func TestOrderByOwner(t *testing.T) {
	owners := map[string]uint64{"a": 2, "b": 1, "c": 2, "d": 0}
	owner := func(table string) (uint64, bool) {
		id, ok := owners[table]
		return id, ok
	}
	batch := []*heldSubmission{{tableID: "a"}, {tableID: "x"}, {tableID: "b"}, {tableID: "d"}, {tableID: "c"}, {tableID: "y"}, {tableID: "b"}}
	want := []*heldSubmission{batch[0], batch[4], batch[2], batch[6], batch[3], batch[1], batch[5]}
	names := func(list []*heldSubmission) []string {
		var out []string
		for _, h := range list {
			out = append(out, h.tableID)
		}
		return out
	}
	if got := orderByOwner(batch, owner); !slices.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("order = %v, want %v", names(got), names(want))
	}
}

// TestGroupingWindowProposesOwnersInFirstArrivalOrder: contract §3.8. Nothing
// is proposed while the window is open; at its close the held statements
// reach the log grouped by owner (owners in the order of their first held
// submission, arrival order within an owner, a table without an owner last)
// and every handler gets its own answer. The next submission opens a new
// window.
func TestGroupingWindowProposesOwnersInFirstArrivalOrder(t *testing.T) {
	s, node, windows := groupingServer(t)
	genesis, ok := node.f.ManifestBySafeBlock(0)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("genesis manifest missing")
	}
	tHash, bHash := genesis.Tables[0].SchemaHash, payloadexec.TableSchemaHash(testServerNetworkID, serverTableB())
	kb, ab := testAccount(t)
	kt, at := testAccount(t)
	kz, az := testAccount(t)
	b1 := heldSubmit(t, s, tableEnvelope(t, kb, ab, 1, "db.b", bHash), 1)
	t1 := heldSubmit(t, s, tableEnvelope(t, kt, at, 1, "db.t", tHash), 2)
	b2 := heldSubmit(t, s, tableEnvelope(t, kb, ab, 2, "db.b", bHash), 3)
	z1 := heldSubmit(t, s, tableEnvelope(t, kz, az, 1, "db.zz", tHash), 4)
	t2 := heldSubmit(t, s, tableEnvelope(t, kt, at, 2, "db.t", tHash), 5)
	if node.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a statement was proposed before its window closed")
	}
	if got := windows.windows(); !slices.Equal(got, []time.Duration{50 * time.Millisecond}) {
		t.Fatalf("windows opened = %v, want one of 50ms", got)
	}
	windows.closeNext(t)
	results := map[string]submitOutcome{"b1": <-b1, "t1": <-t1, "b2": <-b2, "z1": <-z1, "t2": <-t2}
	if got, want := proposedSubmissions(node.recordingNode), []string{"db.b#1", "db.b#2", "db.t#1", "db.t#2", "db.zz#1"}; !slices.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("log order = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	for name, seq := range map[string]uint64{"t1": 1, "t2": 2} {
		if r := results[name]; r.err != nil || r.ack.GetCode() != pb.AdmissionCode_ADMISSION_CODE_ACCEPTED || r.ack.GetStatementSeq() != seq {
			t.Fatalf("%s = %v, %v; want ACCEPTED as statement %d", name, r.ack, r.err, seq)
		}
	}
	for name, table := range map[string]string{"b1": "db.b", "b2": "db.b", "z1": "db.zz"} {
		if r := results[name]; r.err != nil || r.ack.GetCode() != pb.AdmissionCode_ADMISSION_CODE_SCHEMA_NOT_ALLOWED || !strings.Contains(r.ack.GetMessage(), strconv.Quote(table)) {
			t.Fatalf("%s = %v, %v; want SCHEMA_NOT_ALLOWED naming %s", name, r.ack, r.err, table)
		}
	}
	next := heldSubmit(t, s, tableEnvelope(t, kt, at, 3, "db.t", tHash), 1)
	if got := len(windows.windows()); got != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("windows opened in total = %d, want 2", got)
	}
	windows.closeNext(t)
	if r := <-next; r.err != nil || r.ack.GetStatementSeq() != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("the next window's statement = %v, %v", r.ack, r.err)
	}
}

// TestFollowerSubmissionsBypassTheGroupingWindow: a follower holds nothing; it
// answers NotLeader at once, exactly as before.
func TestFollowerSubmissionsBypassTheGroupingWindow(t *testing.T) {
	s, node, windows := groupingServer(t)

}

// TestLeadershipLossFailsHeldSubmissionsWithNotLeader: contract §3.8.
// OnLeadershipLost answers every held submission with the NotLeader error a
// follower returns and proposes none of them; the failed window's late close
// does nothing, and the next submission opens a new window.
func TestLeadershipLossFailsHeldSubmissionsWithNotLeader(t *testing.T) {
	s, node, windows := groupingServer(t)

	second := heldSubmit(t, s, tableEnvelope(t, key, account, 2, "db.t", tHash), 2)

	for name, ch := range map[string]<-chan submitOutcome{"first": first, "second": second} {
		if r := <-ch; !isNotLeader(r.err) {

	windows.closeNext(t)
	if r := <-next; r.err != nil || r.ack.GetCode() != pb.AdmissionCode_ADMISSION_CODE_ACCEPTED {
		t.Fatalf("a submission after the leadership loss = %v, %v", r.ack, r.err)

// TestSubmissionCanceledWhileHeldIsNotProposed: a handler whose context ends
// before its window closes returns the context error, and the grouper skips
// its command at the close, as proposeTracked skips a command whose context
// has ended; the window's other statement is proposed.
func TestSubmissionCanceledWhileHeldIsNotProposed(t *testing.T) {
	s, node, windows := groupingServer(t)
	genesis, _ := node.f.ManifestBySafeBlock(0)
	tHash := genesis.Tables[0].SchemaHash
	kc, ac := testAccount(t)
	kk, ak := testAccount(t)
	canceledEnv := tableEnvelope(t, kc, ac, 1, "db.t", tHash)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	canceled := make(chan submitOutcome, 1)
	go func() {
		ack, err := (&ingressService{s: s}).SubmitStatement(ctx, pbEnvelope(canceledEnv))
		canceled <- submitOutcome{ack, err}
	}()
	waitHeld(t, s.grouper, 1)
	kept := heldSubmit(t, s, tableEnvelope(t, kk, ak, 1, "db.t", tHash), 2)
	cancel()
	if r := <-canceled; status.Code(r.err) != codes.Canceled {
		t.Fatalf("the canceled handler = %v, %v; want Canceled", r.ack, r.err)
	}
	windows.closeNext(t)
	if r := <-kept; r.err != nil || r.ack.GetCode() != pb.AdmissionCode_ADMISSION_CODE_ACCEPTED || r.ack.GetStatementSeq() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the kept statement = %v, %v", r.ack, r.err)
	}
	if got := proposedSubmissions(node.recordingNode); len(got) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("proposed %v, want only the kept statement", got)
	}
	if _, found := node.f.StatementAck(strings.ToLower(ac) + ":1:n"); found {
		t.Fatal("the canceled statement was sequenced")
	}
}
```

```go
func New(d Deps) *Server {
	if d.Logger == nil {
		d.Logger = slog.Default()
	}
	s := &Server{
		d:                d,
		verifiers:        newVerifierRegistry(d.StreamMetrics),
		snodes:           newSNodeRegistry(d.StreamMetrics),
		registryWatchers: newStreamRegistry[struct{}]("table_registry", nil, nil),
		features:         newFeatureBook(),
	}
	if d.Cfg.SubmissionGroupingWindow > 0 {
		s.grouper = newSubmissionGrouper(s, d.Cfg.SubmissionGroupingWindow)
	}
	return s
}
```

```go
func (s *Server) OnLeadershipLost() {
	s.features.clear()
	// Held submissions were never proposed: answer them as a follower would.
	if s.grouper != nil {
		s.grouper.failHeld()
	}
	s.CloseStreams()
}

// Close answers every submission the grouping window still holds with
// NotLeader, stops the window's goroutine and answers later submissions the
// same way. Call it with CloseStreams before grpc.GracefulStop, so no handler
// waits for a window that will never close. It is idempotent.
func (s *Server) Close() {
	if s.grouper != nil {
		s.grouper.close()
	}
}
```

```go
// proposeTracked is propose that also reports whether the command reached the
// Raft log and the index it applied at.
func (s *Server) proposeTracked(ctx context.Context, cmd wire.Command) (any, proposal, error) {
	fut, p, err := s.submitTracked(ctx, cmd)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, p, err
	}
	return s.awaitTracked(ctx, fut, p)
}

// submitTracked is proposeTracked's first half: it encodes cmd and hands it to
// Node.Apply without waiting for the outcome. hashicorp/raft orders the log
// by the order in which Apply calls hand off their futures, so commands
// submitted one after another from one goroutine keep that order; the
// grouping window relies on it.
func (s *Server) submitTracked(ctx context.Context, cmd wire.Command) (raft.ApplyFuture, proposal, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, proposal{}, status.FromContextError(err).Err()
	}
	b, err := wire.Encode(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, proposal{}, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "encode: %v", err)
	}
	return s.d.Node.Apply(b, s.d.Cfg.ApplyTimeout), proposal{submitted: true}, nil
}

// awaitTracked is proposeTracked's second half: it waits for a submitted
// command's outcome and maps it.
func (s *Server) awaitTracked(ctx context.Context, fut raft.ApplyFuture, p proposal) (any, proposal, error) {
	out := waitApply(ctx, fut)
	if err := out.err; err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, raft.ErrNotLeader) || errors.Is(err, raft.ErrLeadershipLost) {
			return nil, p, notLeaderErr(s.leaderAddr())
		}
		if status.Code(err) == codes.Canceled || status.Code(err) == codes.DeadlineExceeded {
			return nil, p, err
		}
		return nil, p, status.Errorf(codes.Unavailable, "apply: %v", err)
	}

	res := out.resp
	// fsm.Rejected is the only result mapped to InvalidArgument here;
	// reportEvidenceRejection and the quarantine RPCs rely on that.
	if r, ok := res.(fsm.Rejected); ok {
		return nil, p, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, r.Reason)
	}
	p.index = out.index
	return res, p, nil
}
```

Create `server/grouper.go`:

```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/hashicorp/raft"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// leaderState is implemented by raftnode.Node: whether this node currently
// holds Raft leadership, read locally (no quorum round).
type leaderState interface {
	IsLeader() bool
}

// isLeader reports local leadership; a node that cannot say never groups.
func (s *Server) isLeader() bool {
	l, ok := s.d.Node.(leaderState)
	return ok && l.IsLeader()
}

// proposeStatement proposes one SubmitStatement command. After the tracks
// activation, on the leader, with a grouping window configured, the command
// waits in the grouper so that each window's statements reach the log
// grouped by owner (housegate spec 2026-10-10 §7.1, contract §3.8). A
// follower, a leader before the activation and a server without a window
// propose at once, exactly as before.
func (s *Server) proposeStatement(ctx context.Context, cmd wire.Command) (any, error) {
	if s.grouper != nil && s.isLeader() && s.d.FSM.TracksActive() {
		return s.grouper.propose(ctx, cmd)
	}
	return s.propose(ctx, cmd)
}

// groupingTimer is the part of *time.Timer the grouper keeps: a window's
// pending close, stopped when its submissions are failed early.
type groupingTimer interface {
	Stop() bool
}

// heldSubmission is one SubmitStatement command waiting for its window to
// close.
type heldSubmission struct {
	ctx     context.Context
	cmd     wire.Command
	tableID string
	// handoff receives exactly one value: the command's Raft future, or the
	// error that kept it out of the log. It is buffered, so the grouper never
	// waits for a handler that already gave up.
	handoff chan submission
}

// submission is what the grouper hands a held handler.
type submission struct {
	fut raft.ApplyFuture
	p   proposal
	err error
}

// submissionGrouper is the leader-local SubmitStatement grouping window. After
// the tracks activation admission seals the open block whenever a statement
// of another owner arrives (contract §3.2), so interleaved writers of two
// indexers would cut a block per statement. The grouper holds the statements
// that arrive within one window and, when the window closes, hands them to
// Raft from one goroutine grouped by owner: owners in the order of their
// first held statement, arrival order within an owner, statements whose table
// has no owner last. The log keeps that order because hashicorp/raft orders
// entries by the order in which Apply calls hand off their futures; each
// handler then awaits its own outcome, so commits still pipeline. Nothing
// here is replicated: the order is the leader's choice and every voter
// applies whatever the log holds.
type submissionGrouper struct {
	s      *Server
	window time.Duration
	// afterFunc schedules a window's close; tests close windows by hand.
	afterFunc func(time.Duration, func()) groupingTimer

	mu sync.Mutex
	// held is the open window's submissions in arrival order; ready holds the
	// closed windows the worker has not taken yet, oldest first.
	held  []*heldSubmission
	ready [][]*heldSubmission
	// gen names the open window. Failing the held submissions moves it on,
	// so a failed window's late close does nothing.
	gen    uint64
	timer  groupingTimer
	closed bool

	wake     chan struct{}
	stop     chan struct{}
	stopOnce sync.Once
}

func newSubmissionGrouper(s *Server, window time.Duration) *submissionGrouper {
	g := &submissionGrouper{
		s:         s,
		window:    window,
		afterFunc: func(d time.Duration, f func()) groupingTimer { return time.AfterFunc(d, f) },
		wake:      make(chan struct{}, 1),
		stop:      make(chan struct{}),
	}
	go g.run()
	return g
}

// propose holds cmd, a SubmitStatement, until its window closes, then waits
// for its own outcome exactly as proposeTracked would.
func (g *submissionGrouper) propose(ctx context.Context, cmd wire.Command) (any, error) {
	h := &heldSubmission{ctx: ctx, cmd: cmd, tableID: cmd.SubmitStatement.Envelope.TargetTableID, handoff: make(chan submission, 1)}
	if !g.hold(h) {
		return nil, notLeaderErr(g.s.leaderAddr())
	}
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, status.FromContextError(ctx.Err()).Err()
	case sub := <-h.handoff:
		if sub.err != nil {
			return nil, sub.err
		}
		res, _, err := g.s.awaitTracked(ctx, sub.fut, sub.p)
		return res, err
	}
}

// hold adds h to the open window, opening one when none is open, and reports
// false once the grouper is closed.
func (g *submissionGrouper) hold(h *heldSubmission) bool {
	g.mu.Lock()
	defer g.mu.Unlock()
	if g.closed {
		return false
	}
	g.held = append(g.held, h)
	if len(g.held) == 1 {
		g.gen++
		gen := g.gen
		g.timer = g.afterFunc(g.window, func() { g.closeWindow(gen) })
	}
	return true
}

// closeWindow hands window gen's submissions to the worker. A window whose
// submissions were already failed is gone, and its close does nothing.
func (g *submissionGrouper) closeWindow(gen uint64) {
	g.mu.Lock()
	if gen != g.gen || len(g.held) == 0 {
		g.mu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	g.ready = append(g.ready, g.held)
	g.held, g.timer = nil, nil
	g.mu.Unlock()
	select {
	case g.wake <- struct{}{}:
	default:
	}
}

// run is the grouper's one proposing goroutine.
func (g *submissionGrouper) run() {
	for {
		select {
		case <-g.stop:
			return
		case <-g.wake:
		}
		g.mu.Lock()
		ready := g.ready
		g.ready = nil
		g.mu.Unlock()
		for _, batch := range ready {
			g.submit(batch)
		}
	}
}

// submit hands one closed window to Raft in owner order. A command whose
// handler's context already ended is not proposed, as proposeTracked would
// not propose it.
func (g *submissionGrouper) submit(batch []*heldSubmission) {
	for _, h := range orderByOwner(batch, g.s.d.FSM.TableOwner) {
		fut, p, err := g.s.submitTracked(h.ctx, h.cmd)
		h.handoff <- submission{fut: fut, p: p, err: err}
	}
}

// failHeld answers every submission not yet handed to Raft (the open window
// and closed windows the worker has not taken) with the NotLeader error a
// follower returns. OnLeadershipLost calls it; the grouper keeps serving.
func (g *submissionGrouper) failHeld() {
	g.fail(false)
}

// close is failHeld that also refuses every later submission and stops the
// worker. Server.Close calls it; it is idempotent.
func (g *submissionGrouper) close() {
	g.fail(true)
	g.stopOnce.Do(func() { close(g.stop) })
}

func (g *submissionGrouper) fail(closing bool) {
	g.mu.Lock()
	batches := g.ready
	if len(g.held) > 0 {
		batches = append(batches, g.held)
	}
	g.held, g.ready = nil, nil
	g.gen++
	if g.timer != nil {
		g.timer.Stop()
		g.timer = nil
	}
	if closing {
		g.closed = true
	}
	g.mu.Unlock()
	err := notLeaderErr(g.s.leaderAddr())
	for _, batch := range batches {
		for _, h := range batch {
			h.handoff <- submission{err: err}
		}
	}
}

// orderByOwner is a closed window's proposal order (contract §3.8): owners in
// the order of their first held submission, arrival order within an owner,
// and submissions whose table owner cannot be resolved last, in arrival
// order.
func orderByOwner(batch []*heldSubmission, owner func(tableID string) (uint64, bool)) []*heldSubmission {
	var owners []uint64
	byOwner := map[uint64][]*heldSubmission{}
	var unresolved []*heldSubmission
	for _, h := range batch {
		id, ok := owner(h.tableID)
		if !ok {
			unresolved = append(unresolved, h)
			continue
		}
		if _, seen := byOwner[id]; !seen {
			owners = append(owners, id)
		}
		byOwner[id] = append(byOwner[id], h)
	}
	out := make([]*heldSubmission, 0, len(batch))
	for _, id := range owners {
		out = append(out, byOwner[id]...)
	}
	return append(out, unresolved...)
}
```

```go
	mustApplyViaNode(t, node, wire.Command{SeedLegacyTables: &wire.SeedLegacyTables{AtBlock: arbiter.L2BlockRef{Number: 149, Hash: "0x149"}, IndexerID: &two}})
}

// sealIndexer2TransitionO adds db.b, owned by indexer 2, at blocks 150/151
// and seals its transition block, returning the block's sequence.
func sealIndexer2TransitionO(t *testing.T, node *fakeNode, params fsm.Params) uint64 {
	t.Helper()
	seedIndexer2O(t, node)
	addOwnedTableO(t, node, params, "db", "b", 150, 151, 2)
	res := mustApplyViaNode(t, node, wire.Command{SealL3Block: &wire.SealL3Block{}})
	sealed, ok := res.(fsm.SealResult)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("seal indexer 2's transition = %T %+v", res, res)
	}
	return sealed.BlockSeq
}

// submitTrackStatementO admits acct's statement seq into the genesis table
// db.t, owned by the founding indexer 1, under its registered schema and with
// payload ref "ref-<seq>".
func submitTrackStatementO(t *testing.T, node *fakeNode, params fsm.Params, acct accountFixture, seq uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	env := validEnvelopeO(t, statementFixture{account: acct, seq: seq})
	env.SchemaHash = genesisManifestO(t, params).Tables[0].SchemaHash
	env.PayloadRef = fmt.Sprintf("ref-%d", seq)
	env.UserJWS = signStatementJWSO(t, acct.key, env)
	res := mustApplyViaNode(t, node, wire.Command{SubmitStatement: &wire.SubmitStatement{Envelope: env}})
	if sr, ok := res.(fsm.SubmitResult); !ok || sr.Code != arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted {
		t.Fatalf("submit %d: %T %+v", seq, res, res)
	}
}

// verifyTrackBlockO binds block blockSeq's one statement to the RC s1 signs
// with signer (its indexer's key after the signed-claims activation), one
// part row-<blockSeq> in partition; marks the block replaying; and records
// attestations and scans from the first replicas members of its verifier set
// (two reach quorum, three also complete the custody evidence).
func verifyTrackBlockO(t *testing.T, node *fakeNode, f *fsm.FSM, signer *authority.Signer, blockSeq uint64, partition string, replicas int) {
	t.Helper()
	info, ok := f.BlockDispatchInfo(blockSeq)
	if !ok || len(info.Statements) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("block %d dispatch info = %+v, %v", blockSeq, info, ok)
	}
	stmt := info.Statements[0]
	partHash := lthashHexO(fmt.Sprintf("row-%d", blockSeq))
	rc := wire.RCFromPB(wire.RCToPB(arbiter.RCRecord{
		StatementID: statementIDFromFlatO(t, stmt.StatementID), SourceNode: "s1", SourceClaimRoot: "0xr00t",
		CandidateParts: []arbiter.CandidatePart{{TableID: stmt.TargetTableID, PartitionID: partition,
			PartName: fmt.Sprintf("all_%d_%d_0", blockSeq, blockSeq), PartRowLtHash: partHash, RowCount: 1, Bytes: 32}},
		PartitionNewPartSums: []arbiter.PartitionLtHashSum{{TableID: stmt.TargetTableID, PartitionID: partition, NewPartsLtHashSum: partHash}},
	}))
	jws, err := signer.SignSNodeMessage(authority.SNodeMessageResultClaim, messageContextO(t, f), rc)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustApplyViaNode(t, node, wire.Command{RegisterRC: &wire.RegisterRC{RC: rc, SourceJWS: jws}})
	markReplayingViaNode(t, node, blockSeq)
	for _, rid := range verifierSetOf(t, f, blockSeq)[:replicas] {
		applyAttestationViaNode(t, node, f, blockSeq, rid)
		applyScanViaNode(t, node, f, blockSeq, rid)
	}
}

// drivePromotionsO runs handlePromotionRows over a fresh WorkSet, as
// successive rescans would, until done holds; at most eight passes.
func drivePromotionsO(t *testing.T, o *Loop, f *fsm.FSM, what string, done func(fsm.WorkSet) bool) {
	t.Helper()
	for pass := 0; pass < 8; pass++ {
		ws, err := f.WorkSet()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if done(ws) {
			return
		}
		if err := o.handlePromotionRows(t.Context(), ws); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("%s: not reached after eight passes", what)
}

// ackSignedCleanupViaNode is the source's signed acknowledgement of the
// scheduled cleanup of promotionSeq (applyRecordCleanupAck after the
// signed-claims activation), the cleanup twin of ackSignedPromotionViaNode.
func ackSignedCleanupViaNode(t *testing.T, node *fakeNode, f *fsm.FSM, signer *authority.Signer, nodeID string, promotionSeq uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	ws, err := f.WorkSet()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("workset: %v", err)
	}
	for _, cw := range ws.ScheduledUnackedCleanups {
		if cw.PromotionSeq != promotionSeq {
			continue
		}
		ack := wire.CleanupAckFromPB(wire.CleanupAckToPB(arbiter.CleanupAck{NodeID: nodeID, PromotionSeq: promotionSeq,
			TableID: cw.Cleanup.TableID, PartitionID: cw.Cleanup.PartitionID}))
		jws, err := signer.SignSNodeMessage(authority.SNodeMessageCleanupAck, messageContextO(t, f), ack)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		mustApplyViaNode(t, node, wire.Command{RecordCleanupAck: &wire.RecordCleanupAck{Ack: ack, SourceJWS: jws}})
		return
	}
	t.Fatalf("cleanup of promotion %d not scheduled: %+v", promotionSeq, ws.ScheduledUnackedCleanups)
}

// sentLenO and sentSinceO read fakeSNodes' sends under its lock.
func sentLenO(fsn *fakeSNodes) int {
	fsn.mu.Lock()
	defer fsn.mu.Unlock()
	return len(fsn.sent)
}

func sentSinceO(fsn *fakeSNodes, from int) ([]*pb.PromotionCommand, []string) {
	fsn.mu.Lock()
	defer fsn.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]*pb.PromotionCommand(nil), fsn.sent[from:]...), append([]string(nil), fsn.to[from:]...)
}

// jwsPayloadO decodes an authority token's payload.
func jwsPayloadO(t *testing.T, token string) authority.JWSCommandPayload {
	t.Helper()
	parts := strings.Split(token, ".")
	if len(parts) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("token has %d parts", len(parts))
	}
	raw, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(parts[1])
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var payload authority.JWSCommandPayload
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return payload
}

// stuckTrackTwoO is tracksHarnessO with block 1 indexer 2's transition block,
// which nobody verifies, so track 2 and the global safe prefix stay below
// it, and block 2 an indexer-1 statement block (partition p0) verified by all
// three verifiers, anchored, promoted and acknowledged: track 1's prefix is 2
// and awaits its manifest.
func stuckTrackTwoO(t *testing.T) (*fsm.FSM, *Loop) {
	t.Helper()
	f, node, _, o, params, _ := tracksHarnessO(t)
	if seq := sealIndexer2TransitionO(t, node, params); seq != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("indexer 2's transition sealed as block %d, want 1", seq)
	}
	key0 := authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex0)
	submitTrackStatementO(t, node, params, testAccountO(t), 1)
	sealViaNode(t, node)
	verifyTrackBlockO(t, node, f, key0, 2, "p0", 3)
	drivePromotionsO(t, o, f, "promotion of block 2 issued", func(ws fsm.WorkSet) bool { return len(ws.IssuedUnacked) == 1 })
	ackSignedPromotionViaNode(t, node, f, key0, "s1", 1)
	ws, err := f.WorkSet()
	if err != nil || !ws.NeedManifest || f.SafeWatermarkView().SafeBlockSeq != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("track 1 must await its manifest behind a stuck track 2: %+v, %v", ws, err)
	}
	return f, o
}
```

Create `orchestrator/tracks_test.go`:

```go
package orchestrator

import (
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// TestReleasedTrackWorkIsRedispatchedUnderTheNewAuthority (Review Focus 4):
// indexer 1's track holds an issued, unacknowledged promotion (2) and a
// scheduled, unacknowledged cleanup (of promotion 1) when it is quarantined.
// Nothing of it is dispatched while the track is quarantined; the authority
// rotates from A to B meanwhile (the drain gate skips the quarantined
// track); after the release, signed by B, one pass dispatches both again to
// the owner's SNode, re-signed by B under the new epoch, and the SNode, whose
// static allowlist names both authorities (clarification C12), acknowledges
// them.
func TestReleasedTrackWorkIsRedispatchedUnderTheNewAuthority(t *testing.T) {
	f, node, fsn, o, params, signerA := tracksHarnessO(t)
	_, signerB := authorityParamsO(t)
	key0 := authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex0)
	acct := testAccountO(t)

	// Block 1 (track 1, partition p0): promotion 1 is issued, acknowledged
	// and published, so its cleanup is scheduled; nobody acknowledges it.
	submitTrackStatementO(t, node, params, acct, 1)
	sealViaNode(t, node)
	verifyTrackBlockO(t, node, f, key0, 1, "p0", 2)
	drivePromotionsO(t, o, f, "promotion 1 issued", func(ws fsm.WorkSet) bool { return len(ws.IssuedUnacked) == 1 })
	ackSignedPromotionViaNode(t, node, f, key0, "s1", 1)
	drivePromotionsO(t, o, f, "cleanup of promotion 1 scheduled", func(ws fsm.WorkSet) bool { return len(ws.ScheduledUnackedCleanups) == 1 })

	// Block 2 (track 1, partition p1): promotion 2 is issued; nobody
	// acknowledges it.
	submitTrackStatementO(t, node, params, acct, 2)
	sealViaNode(t, node)
	verifyTrackBlockO(t, node, f, key0, 2, "p1", 2)
	drivePromotionsO(t, o, f, "promotion 2 issued", func(ws fsm.WorkSet) bool {
		return len(ws.IssuedUnacked) == 1 && ws.IssuedUnacked[0].Promote.PromotionSeq == 2
	})

	// Quarantine indexer 1 under authority A: its work leaves the work set
	// (clarification C8) and a pass dispatches nothing.
	quarantine := wire.QuarantineIndexer{IndexerID: 1, ExpectedGeneration: 0, Reason: "source of indexer 1 is stuck"}
	token, err := signerA.SignQuarantineIndexerWithContext(quarantine.Canonical(), authorityContextO(t, f))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	quarantine.AuthorityJWS = token
	mustApplyViaNode(t, node, wire.Command{QuarantineIndexer: &quarantine})
	ws, err := f.WorkSet()
	if err != nil || len(ws.IssuedUnacked) != 0 || len(ws.ScheduledUnackedCleanups) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a quarantined track's work stayed in the work set: %+v, %v", ws, err)
	}
	sent := sentLenO(fsn)
	if err := o.handlePromotionRows(t.Context(), ws); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if sentLenO(fsn) != sent {
		t.Fatal("a quarantined track's work was dispatched")
	}

	// Rotate the authority from A to B while indexer 1 is quarantined.
	applyTracksUpdateO(t, node, f, signerA, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) { u.AuthorityAddresses = []string{signerB.Address()} })
	newContext := authorityContextO(t, f)

	// Release indexer 1 under authority B: both items are back.
	release := wire.ReleaseIndexer{IndexerID: 1, ExpectedGeneration: 1}
	if release.AuthorityJWS, err = signerB.SignReleaseIndexerWithContext(release.Canonical(), newContext); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustApplyViaNode(t, node, wire.Command{ReleaseIndexer: &release})
	ws, err = f.WorkSet()
	if err != nil || len(ws.IssuedUnacked) != 1 || ws.IssuedUnacked[0].Promote.PromotionSeq != 2 ||
		len(ws.ScheduledUnackedCleanups) != 1 || ws.ScheduledUnackedCleanups[0].PromotionSeq != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("after the release the work set lacks the suspended work: %+v, %v", ws, err)
	}

	// The leader now signs with B: one pass dispatches both, re-signed.
	deps := o.d
	deps.Signer = signerB
	current := New(deps)
	sent = sentLenO(fsn)
	if err := current.handlePromotionRows(t.Context(), ws); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	msgs, targets := sentSinceO(fsn, sent)
	snodeAllowlist := authority.Validator{AllowedAddresses: map[string]bool{signerA.Address(): true, signerB.Address(): true}, MaxTokenAge: time.Minute}
	newAuthorityOnly := authority.Validator{AllowedAddresses: map[string]bool{signerB.Address(): true}, MaxTokenAge: time.Minute}
	authorize := func(v authority.Validator, msg *pb.PromotionCommand) (string, error) {
		if promote := msg.GetPromote(); promote != nil {
			return v.AuthorizePromotion(wire.PromoteFromPB(promote), msg.GetAuthorityJws())
		}
		return v.AuthorizeCleanup(wire.CleanupFromPB(msg.GetCleanup()), msg.GetAuthorityJws())
	}
	var promotions, cleanups int
	for i, msg := range msgs {
		switch {
		case msg.GetPromote() != nil && msg.GetPromote().GetPromotionSeq() == 2:
			promotions++
		case msg.GetCleanup() != nil && msg.GetCleanup().GetPromotionSeq() == 1:
			cleanups++
		default:
			t.Fatalf("unexpected dispatch %v", msg)
		}
		if targets[i] != "s1" {
			t.Fatalf("dispatched to %s, want the owner's SNode s1", targets[i])
		}
		if signer, err := authorize(snodeAllowlist, msg); err != nil || signer != signerB.Address() {
			t.Fatalf("SNode allowlist {A, B}: signer %s, %v; want B", signer, err)
		}
		if _, err := authorize(newAuthorityOnly, msg); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("the dispatch does not verify under the new authority alone: %v", err)
		}
		payload := jwsPayloadO(t, msg.GetAuthorityJws())
		if payload.NetworkID != newContext.NetworkID || payload.GenesisSnapshotID != newContext.GenesisSnapshotID ||
			payload.AuthorityEpoch == nil || *payload.AuthorityEpoch != newContext.AuthorityEpoch {
			t.Fatalf("the dispatch is not bound to the new authority context %+v: %+v", newContext, payload)
		}
	}
	if promotions != 1 || cleanups != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("dispatched %d promotions and %d cleanups, want one of each", promotions, cleanups)
	}

	// The SNode acknowledges both; nothing of the track's work is left.
	ackSignedPromotionViaNode(t, node, f, key0, "s1", 2)
	ackSignedCleanupViaNode(t, node, f, key0, "s1", 1)
	if ws, err = f.WorkSet(); err != nil || len(ws.IssuedUnacked) != 0 || len(ws.ScheduledUnackedCleanups) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("after the acknowledgements: %+v, %v", ws, err)
	}
}

// TestSealLoopSealsOneTransitionPerOwnerInOnePass: contract §3.8. After the
// tracks activation each owner seals its own transition block; one pass of
// the seal loop drains the open block, then seals indexer 1's transition and
// indexer 2's: three proposals, within its bound of the enrolled indexers
// plus one.
func TestSealLoopSealsOneTransitionPerOwnerInOnePass(t *testing.T) {
	f, node, _, o, params, _ := tracksHarnessO(t)
	submitTrackStatementO(t, node, params, testAccountO(t), 1)
	addOwnedTableO(t, node, params, "db", "a", 100, 101, 1)
	seedIndexer2O(t, node)
	addOwnedTableO(t, node, params, "db", "b", 150, 151, 2)
	if !f.TableSetTransitionPending() {
		t.Fatal("the fixture must have pending changes")
	}
	before := node.applyCount()
	if err := o.checkSeal(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := node.applyCount() - before; got != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("one pass made %d proposals, want 3", got)
	}
	for i, want := range []struct {
		transition bool
		track      uint64
	}{{false, 1}, {true, 1}, {true, 2}} {
		info, ok := f.BlockDispatchInfo(uint64(i + 1))
		if !ok || (info.Header.TableSetTransition != nil) != want.transition || info.Header.Track == nil || info.Header.Track.IndexerID != want.track {
			t.Fatalf("block %d = %+v, want transition %v on track %d", i+1, info.Header, want.transition, want.track)
		}
	}
	if f.TableSetTransitionPending() {
		t.Fatal("a change is still pending after the pass")
	}
}

// TestSealLoopBeforeTheTracksActivationProposesDrainAndOneTransition: before
// the activation one transition block carries every pending change, so a pass
// makes today's two proposals and no header has a track.
func TestSealLoopBeforeTheTracksActivationProposesDrainAndOneTransition(t *testing.T) {
	f, node, _, o, params := baseRegistryHarness(t)

// TestBlockSealedEventsTimeSealsOnlyAfterTheTracksActivation: contract §3.8.
// After the activation a seal the loop did not propose (an owner switch
// inside admission) is timed from its EventBlockSealed and observed once its
// track is published; before it the event is only a wakeup, as before.
func TestBlockSealedEventsTimeSealsOnlyAfterTheTracksActivation(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Unix(1000, 0)
	params, signer := authorityParamsO(t)
	_, node, _, _, _, before, _ := newHarness(t, params, signer)
	seedGenesisWriterAndVerifiers(t, node)
	before.d.Metrics = &promotionMetricsRecorder{}
	before.now = func() time.Time { return now }
	if err := before.onEvent(t.Context(), fsm.Event{Kind: fsm.EventBlockSealed, BlockSeq: 1}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(before.sealedAt) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a pre-activation event recorded seal times %v", before.sealedAt)
	}

	_, _, _, after, _, _ := tracksHarnessO(t)
	metrics := &promotionMetricsRecorder{}
	after.d.Metrics = metrics
	after.now = func() time.Time { return now }
	if err := after.onEvent(t.Context(), fsm.Event{Kind: fsm.EventBlockSealed, BlockSeq: 1}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if sealed, ok := after.sealedAt[1]; !ok || !sealed.Equal(time.Unix(1000, 0)) {
		t.Fatalf("seal time of block 1 = %v, %v", sealed, ok)
	}
	now = now.Add(3 * time.Second)
	after.observeTrackBlocks([]uint64{1})
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(metrics.durations, []time.Duration{3 * time.Second}) || metrics.unobserved != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("metrics = %+v", metrics)
	}
}

// TestPublicationTimesOnlyTheAdvancedTracksBlocks: contract §3.8. Track 2 is
// stuck below block 1, so the publication track 1 triggers leaves the global
// watermark at 0 (clarification C6); it times block 2 (track 1), keeps block
// 1's seal time pending, and its log line names track 1.
func TestPublicationTimesOnlyTheAdvancedTracksBlocks(t *testing.T) {
	f, o := stuckTrackTwoO(t)
	metrics := &promotionMetricsRecorder{}
	now := time.Unix(1000, 0)
	o.d.Metrics = metrics
	o.now = func() time.Time { return now }
	o.recordSealTime(1)
	o.recordSealTime(2)
	now = now.Add(5 * time.Second)
	logs := captureLogs(o)
	if err := o.publishManifest(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if wm, track := f.SafeWatermarkView().SafeBlockSeq, f.TrackStateView().Indexers[0].Published; wm != 0 || track.SafeBlockSeq != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("publication: watermark %d, track 1 published %+v", wm, track)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(metrics.durations, []time.Duration{5 * time.Second}) || metrics.unobserved != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("metrics = %+v", metrics)
	}
	if _, pending := o.sealedAt[1]; !pending {
		t.Fatal("track 2's block lost its seal time to track 1's publication")
	}
	if out := logs.String(); !strings.Contains(out, "safe watermark advanced") || !strings.Contains(out, "advanced_tracks=[1]") {
		t.Fatalf("the publication log does not name track 1:\n%s", out)
	}
}

// TestSafeWatermarkLogIsUnchangedBeforeTheTracksActivation: before the
// activation a publication is timed on the global watermark and its log line
// carries exactly today's attributes.
func TestSafeWatermarkLogIsUnchangedBeforeTheTracksActivation(t *testing.T) {
	params, signer := authorityParamsO(t)
	f, node, _, _, _, o, _ := newHarness(t, params, signer)
	seedGenesisWriterAndVerifiers(t, node)
	driveToQuorum(t, node, f)
	drivePromotionsO(t, o, f, "promotion 1 issued", func(ws fsm.WorkSet) bool { return len(ws.IssuedUnacked) == 1 })
	ackPromotionViaNode(t, node, f, 1)
	logs := captureLogs(o)
	if err := o.publishManifest(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)

	out := logs.String()
	if !strings.Contains(out, "safe watermark advanced") || !strings.Contains(out, "safe_block_seq=1") || strings.Contains(out, "advanced_tracks") {
		t.Fatalf("the pre-activation publication log changed:\n%s", out)
	}
}

// TestCustodyAuditsABlockOnceItsTrackIsPublished: contract §3.8. Track 1's
// publication covers block 2 while the global watermark stays at 0 behind
// track 2's unverified block 1; block 2's custody moves to AUDIT, block 1's
// does not.
func TestCustodyAuditsABlockOnceItsTrackIsPublished(t *testing.T) {
	f, o := stuckTrackTwoO(t)
	if err := o.publishManifest(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rows := f.CustodyWorkSet()
	if len(rows) != 2 || rows[0].Safe || !rows[1].Safe || !rows[1].EvidenceComplete || f.SafeWatermarkView().SafeBlockSeq != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("custody rows = %+v, watermark %d", rows, f.SafeWatermarkView().SafeBlockSeq)
	}
	custody := &fakeCustody{}
	o.d.Custody = custody
	o.resetCustodyStages()
	if err := o.advanceCustody(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []string{
		"pin|PIN_PURPOSE_REPLAY|2|ref-1",
		"release|PIN_PURPOSE_SEQUENCED|1|",
		"pin|PIN_PURPOSE_AUDIT|2|ref-1",
		"release|PIN_PURPOSE_REPLAY|2|",
	}
	if got := custody.snapshot(); !slicesEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("custody calls = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
}
```

`orchestrator/seal.go` — replace `sealTableSetTransition` (53-97) with:

```go
// sealTableSetTransition seals committed registry change sets (ruling R2).
// SealL3Block seals the open block when it holds statements and a transition
// block when it is empty, so the first proposal drains any statement already
// admitted (a retire waits for its table's statements to be sealed) and the
// next one seals a transition. The age and size thresholds do not apply: a
// table-set change is never batched behind them.
//
// Before the tracks activation one transition block carries every owner's
// changes, so two proposals suffice: FSM admission (fsm.applySubmitStatement)
// fences new statements with tableSetTransitionAdmissionFencedReason for the
// whole time FSM.TableSetTransitionPending() is true, i.e. from now until the
// transition is sealed. Without that fence, a statement admitted between the
// drain and the transition seal would land in a fresh open block and get
// sealed on its own, starving the transition under sustained ingest (finding
// 2b-1). After the activation each owner with a sealable change seals its own
// transition block, one after another while the fence still holds (contract
// §3.2), so the pass repeats while a change is pending, bounded by
// transitionSealBound.
func (o *Loop) sealTableSetTransition(ctx context.Context) error {
	bound := o.transitionSealBound()
	for attempt := 0; attempt < bound && o.d.FSM.TableSetTransitionPending(); attempt++ {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		result, err := o.propose(wire.Command{SealL3Block: &wire.SealL3Block{}})
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, ErrRejected) {
				// The FSM reported the change set sealable a moment ago, so a
				// rejection here means committed state moved underneath the
				// proposal or the two decisions diverged. Either way no
				// transition was sealed; say so loudly rather than retrying
				// silently every tick.
				reason := ""
				if r, ok := result.(fsm.Rejected); ok {
					reason = r.Reason
				}
				o.d.Logger.Error("table-set transition seal rejected", "attempt", attempt, "reason", reason)
				return nil
			}
			return err
		}
		if sealed, ok := result.(fsm.SealResult); ok {
			o.recordSealTime(sealed.BlockSeq)
		}
	}
	o.openStart = 0
	o.openFirstSeen = time.Time{}
	return nil
}

// transitionSealBound is how many SealL3Block proposals one pass may make for
// committed table-set changes: today's two (drain, then the one transition)
// before the tracks activation; after it one drain plus one transition per
// enrolled indexer (contract §3.8).
func (o *Loop) transitionSealBound() int {
	if !o.d.FSM.TracksActive() {
		return 2
	}
	view, err := o.d.FSM.ConsensusParamsView()
	if err != nil {
		return 2
	}
	return len(view.Current.SIIndexers) + 1
}
```
